item.title: Privacy Policy
item.dc:creator: hussnain
item.content:encoded:
Who we are

Suggested text: Our website address is: https://zevqyn.free.je.

Comments

Suggested text: When visitors leave comments on the site we collect the data shown in the comments form, and also the visitor’s IP address and browser user agent string to help spam detection.

An anonymized string created from your email address (also called a hash) may be provided to the Gravatar service to see if you are using it. The Gravatar service privacy policy is available here: https://automattic.com/privacy/. After approval of your comment, your profile picture is visible to the public in the context of your comment.

Media

Suggested text: If you upload images to the website, you should avoid uploading images with embedded location data (EXIF GPS) included. Visitors to the website can download and extract any location data from images on the website.

Cookies

Suggested text: If you leave a comment on our site you may opt-in to saving your name, email address and website in cookies. These are for your convenience so that you do not have to fill in your details again when you leave another comment. These cookies will last for one year.

If you visit our login page, we will set a temporary cookie to determine if your browser accepts cookies. This cookie contains no personal data and is discarded when you close your browser.

When you log in, we will also set up several cookies to save your login information and your screen display choices. Login cookies last for two days, and screen options cookies last for a year. If you select "Remember Me", your login will persist for two weeks. If you log out of your account, the login cookies will be removed.

If you edit or publish an article, an additional cookie will be saved in your browser. This cookie includes no personal data and simply indicates the post ID of the article you just edited. It expires after 1 day.

Embedded content from other websites

Suggested text: Articles on this site may include embedded content (e.g. videos, images, articles, etc.). Embedded content from other websites behaves in the exact same way as if the visitor has visited the other website.

These websites may collect data about you, use cookies, embed additional third-party tracking, and monitor your interaction with that embedded content, including tracking your interaction with the embedded content if you have an account and are logged in to that website.

Who we share your data with

Suggested text: If you request a password reset, your IP address will be included in the reset email.

How long we retain your data

Suggested text: If you leave a comment, the comment and its metadata are retained indefinitely. This is so we can recognize and approve any follow-up comments automatically instead of holding them in a moderation queue.

For users that register on our website (if any), we also store the personal information they provide in their user profile. All users can see, edit, or delete their personal information at any time (except they cannot change their username). Website administrators can also see and edit that information.

What rights you have over your data

Suggested text: If you have an account on this site, or have left comments, you can request to receive an exported file of the personal data we hold about you, including any data you have provided to us. You can also request that we erase any personal data we hold about you. This does not include any data we are obliged to keep for administrative, legal, or security purposes.

Where your data is sent

Suggested text: Visitor comments may be checked through an automated spam detection service.

item.dc:creator: hussnain
item.content:encoded:
<!-- wp:html -->
<style data-wp-block-html="css">
/* =========================================================
   ZEVQYN ABOUT PAGE
   ========================================================= */

.zabout {
    --za-green: #25e879;
    --za-green-soft: #75f6a6;
    --za-bg: #020604;
    --za-card: #06100b;
    --za-card-2: #08130e;
    --za-line: rgba(99, 255, 158, 0.17);
    --za-text: #f5fff8;
    --za-muted: #89a99a;

    position: relative;
    width: 100%;
    overflow: hidden;
    background:
        radial-gradient(circle at 80% 5%, rgba(26, 255, 113, 0.07), transparent 28%),
        radial-gradient(circle at 15% 48%, rgba(26, 255, 113, 0.035), transparent 25%),
        var(--za-bg);

    color: var(--za-text);
    font-family: inherit;
}

.zabout *,
.zabout *::before,
.zabout *::after {
    box-sizing: border-box;
}

.za-wrap {
    width: min(1180px, calc(100% - 48px));
    margin: 0 auto;
}

.za-hero {
    min-height: 790px;
    position: relative;

<script data-wp-block-html="js">
function zevqynAboutInitialize() {

    var revealItems = document.querySelectorAll(".za-reveal");

    if ("IntersectionObserver" in window) {

        var revealObserver = new IntersectionObserver(
            function (entries) {

                entries.forEach(function (entry) {

                    if (entry.isIntersecting) {
                        entry.target.classList.add("za-visible");
                        revealObserver.unobserve(entry.target);
                    }

                });

            },
            {
                threshold: 0.12
            }
        );

        revealItems.forEach(function (item) {
            revealObserver.observe(item);
        });

    } else {

        revealItems.forEach(function (item) {
            item.classList.add("za-visible");
        });

    }


    var visual = document.querySelector(".za-visual");

    if (visual) {

        visual.addEventListener("mousemove", function (event) {

            if (window.innerWidth <= 1024) {
                return;
            }

            var rect = visual.getBoundingClientRect();

            var mouseX = event.clientX - rect.left;
            var mouseY = event.clientY - rect.top;

            var rotateY =
                ((mouseX / rect.width) - 0.5) * 3;

            var rotateX =
                ((mouseY / rect.height) - 0.5) * -3;

            visual.style.transform =
                "rotate(-1.5deg) perspective(1000px) rotateX(" +
                rotateX +
                "deg) rotateY(" +
                rotateY +
                "deg)";
        });


        visual.addEventListener("mouseleave", function () {

            visual.style.transform =
                "rotate(-1.5deg) perspective(1000px) rotateX(0deg) rotateY(0deg)";

        });

    }

}


if (document.readyState === "loading") {

    document.addEventListener(
        "DOMContentLoaded",
        function () {
            zevqynAboutInitialize();
        }
    );

} else {

    zevqynAboutInitialize();

}
</script>

<!-- wp:html -->
<style data-wp-block-html="css">
/* =========================================
   HIDE WORDPRESS PAGE TITLE
   ========================================= */

.hero-section,
.entry-header {
    display: none !important;
}


/* =========================================
   BASE
   ========================================= */

#zev-contact-page,
#zev-contact-page * {
    box-sizing: border-box;
}

#zev-contact-page {
    --green: #35dc78;
    --green2: #91ffb9;
    --bg: #020504;
    --panel: #06100c;
    --panel2: #08140f;
    --border: #173328;
    --text: #f6faf8;
    --muted: #849b91;

    width: 100%;
    overflow: hidden;

    color: var(--text);
    background:
        radial-gradient(
            circle at 78% 8%,
            rgba(53, 220, 120, .075),
            transparent 25%
        ),
        var(--bg);

    font-family:
        Inter,
        -apple-system,
        BlinkMacSystemFont,
        "Segoe UI",
        sans-serif;
}

.zct-container {
    width: min(1180px, calc(100% - 44px));
    margin: 0 auto;
}

.zct-section-label,
.zct-eyebrow {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;

    gap: 10px;

    color: var(--green);

    font-size: 9px;
    font-weight: 850;
    letter-spacing: .17em;
}

.zct-section-label > span {
    width: 29px;
    height: 29px;

    display: inline-flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;

    border: 1px solid rgba(53, 220, 120, .3);
    border-radius: 50%;

    font-size: 7px;
    letter-spacing: 0;
}

.zct-eyebrow > span {
    width: 28px;
    height: 1px;

    background: var(--green);
}


/* =========================================
   HERO
   ========================================= */

.zct-hero {
    min-height: 730px;

    position: relative;

    padding: 105px 0;

    display: flex;
    align-items: center;

    border-bottom:
        1px solid rgba(71, 118, 97, .1);
}

.zct-hero::before {
    content: "";

    position: absolute;
    inset: 0;

    opacity: .15;

    background-image:
        linear-gradient(
            rgba(80, 137, 112, .08) 1px,
            transparent 1px
        ),
        linear-gradient(
            90deg,
            rgba(80, 137, 112, .08) 1px,
            transparent 1px
        );

    background-size: 70px 70px;

    mask-image:
        linear-gradient(
            to bottom,
            #000,
            transparent
        );

    pointer-events: none;
}

.zct-hero-grid {
    position: relative;
    z-index: 2;

    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: .9fr 1.1fr;

    gap: 75px;
    align-items: center;
}

.zct-hero-copy h1 {
    margin: 22px 0 22px;

    font-size: clamp(56px, 6vw, 84px);
    line-height: .96;

    letter-spacing: -.055em;
}

.zct-hero-copy h1 span {
    color: var(--green);
}

.zct-hero-copy > p {
    max-width: 560px;

    margin: 0;

    color: var(--muted);

    font-size: 16px;
    line-height: 1.75;
}

.zct-hero-note {
    margin-top: 32px;

    display: flex;
    align-items: center;

    gap: 14px;
}

.zct-note-arrow {
    color: var(--green);

    font-size: 25px;

    transform: rotate(10deg);
}

.zct-hero-note strong,
.zct-hero-note span {
    display: block;
}

.zct-hero-note strong {
    color: #dbe9e2;

    font-size: 11px;
}

.zct-hero-note span {
    margin-top: 3px;

    color: #61796e;

    font-size: 9px;
}


/* =========================================
   RUNNING GREEN BORDER
   ========================================= */

@property --zct-angle {
    syntax: "<angle>";
    initial-value: 0deg;
    inherits: false;
}

.zct-running-border {
    position: relative;

    isolation: isolate;
    overflow: hidden;

    border: 1px solid transparent;

    background:
        linear-gradient(
            #06100c,
            #06100c
        ) padding-box,

        conic-gradient(
            from var(--zct-angle),
            transparent 0deg,
            transparent 300deg,
            rgba(53, 220, 120, .08) 315deg,
            rgba(53, 220, 120, .55) 332deg,
            #35dc78 345deg,
            #a4ffc4 352deg,
            #35dc78 357deg,
            transparent 360deg
        ) border-box;

    animation:
        zctBorderRun 4s linear infinite;
}

@keyframes zctBorderRun {

    from {
        --zct-angle: 0deg;
    }

    to {
        --zct-angle: 360deg;
    }
}


/* =========================================
   HERO VISUAL
   ========================================= */

.zct-hero-visual {
    min-height: 500px;

    border-radius: 20px;

    box-shadow:
        0 30px 80px rgba(0, 0, 0, .45),
        0 0 60px rgba(53, 220, 120, .04);

    transform: rotate(1.5deg);
}

.zct-visual-inner {
    min-height: 498px;

    position: relative;

    padding: 32px;

    overflow: hidden;

    border-radius: 19px;

    background:
        radial-gradient(
            circle at 80% 20%,
            rgba(53, 220, 120, .09),
            transparent 30%
        ),
        #06100c;
}

.zct-visual-top {
    display: flex;
    justify-content: space-between;
    align-items: center;

    color: #587267;

    font-size: 7px;
    letter-spacing: .15em;
}

.zct-online {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;

    gap: 7px;
}

.zct-online i {
    width: 6px;
    height: 6px;

    display: block;

    border-radius: 50%;

    background: var(--green);

    box-shadow:
        0 0 12px var(--green);
}

.zct-message-window {
    margin-top: 70px;
}

.zct-message-user {
    width: 76%;

    margin-left: auto;
    padding: 18px;

    border: 1px solid #1b392e;
    border-radius: 15px 15px 3px 15px;

    background: #0c1914;
}

.zct-message-user small,
.zct-message-zev small {
    color: #59766a;

    font-size: 6px;
    letter-spacing: .15em;
}

.zct-message-user p {
    margin: 8px 0 0;

    color: #b2c4bc;

    font-size: 11px;
    line-height: 1.6;
}

.zct-message-line {
    width: 1px;
    height: 45px;

    margin: 8px 0 8px 65px;

    background:
        linear-gradient(
            var(--green),
            transparent
        );
}

.zct-message-zev {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;

    gap: 12px;
}

.zct-zev-avatar {
    width: 44px;
    height: 44px;

    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;

    border-radius: 12px;

    background: var(--green);
    color: #03180b;

    font-weight: 900;
}

.zct-message-zev p {
    margin: 4px 0 0;

    font-size: 16px;
    font-weight: 750;
}

.zct-floating-tag {
    position: absolute;

    padding: 9px 12px;

    border: 1px solid #26503e;
    border-radius: 8px;

    background: #07110d;

    color: var(--green);

    font-size: 8px;

    box-shadow:
        0 12px 30px rgba(0, 0, 0, .4);
}

.zct-tag-one {
    left: 30px;
    bottom: 75px;

    transform: rotate(-4deg);
}

.zct-tag-two {
    right: 35px;
    top: 105px;

    transform: rotate(4deg);
}

.zct-hand-note {
    position: absolute;

    right: 30px;
    bottom: 27px;

    color: #b4c9bf;

    font-size: 11px;
    font-style: italic;

    text-align: right;

    transform: rotate(-3deg);
}


/* =========================================
   GLOWS
   ========================================= */

.zct-glow {
    position: absolute;

    border-radius: 50%;

    filter: blur(100px);

    pointer-events: none;
}

.zct-glow-one {
    width: 400px;
    height: 400px;

    right: 4%;
    top: 15%;

    background:
        rgba(53, 220, 120, .06);
}

.zct-glow-two {
    width: 260px;
    height: 260px;

    left: 5%;
    bottom: 0;

    background:
        rgba(74, 72, 255, .035);
}


/* =========================================
   GENERAL SECTION HEADINGS
   ========================================= */

.zct-types,
.zct-contact,
.zct-help,
.zct-faq,
.zct-final {
    padding: 110px 0;
}

.zct-section-head {
    max-width: 720px;

    margin-bottom: 50px;
}

.zct-section-head h2,
.zct-contact-copy h2,
.zct-faq-copy h2,
.zct-final h2 {
    margin: 20px 0 13px;

    font-size: clamp(38px, 4.5vw, 58px);
    line-height: 1.03;

    letter-spacing: -.045em;
}

.zct-section-head h2 span,
.zct-contact-copy h2 span,
.zct-faq-copy h2 span,
.zct-final h2 span {
    color: var(--green);
}

.zct-section-head > p,
.zct-contact-copy > p,
.zct-faq-copy > p {
    color: var(--muted);

    font-size: 13px;
    line-height: 1.7;
}


/* =========================================
   CONTACT TYPES
   ========================================= */

.zct-type-grid {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr);

    gap: 12px;
}

.zct-type-card {
    min-height: 170px;

    padding: 22px;

    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    align-items: flex-start;

    position: relative;

    cursor: pointer;

    border: 1px solid var(--border);
    border-radius: 14px;

    background:
        linear-gradient(
            145deg,
            #08130f,
            #050b08
        );

    color: var(--text);

    text-align: left;

    transition:
        transform .25s ease,
        border-color .25s ease,
        background .25s ease;
}

.zct-type-card:hover,
.zct-type-card.zct-selected {
    transform: translateY(-5px);

    border-color:
        rgba(53, 220, 120, .45);

    background:
        linear-gradient(
            145deg,
            rgba(53, 220, 120, .07),
            #050b08
        );
}

.zct-type-icon {
    width: 38px;
    height: 38px;

    margin-bottom: 28px;

    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;

    border-radius: 10px;

    background:

</style>

<script data-wp-block-html="js">
function zevContactInitialize() {

    var contactForm =
        document.getElementById("zct-contact-form");

    var subjectField =
        document.getElementById("zct-subject");

    var messageField =
        document.getElementById("zct-message");

    var countField =
        document.getElementById("zct-count");

    var responseBox =
        document.getElementById("zct-form-response");

    var submitButton =
        document.getElementById("zct-submit");

    var typeCards =
        document.querySelectorAll(
            "#zev-contact-page .zct-type-card"
        );


    /* =====================================
       CONTACT TYPE CARDS
       ===================================== */

    typeCards.forEach(function (card) {

        card.addEventListener(
            "click",
            function () {

                typeCards.forEach(
                    function (item) {

                        item.classList.remove(
                            "zct-selected"
                        );

                    }
                );

                card.classList.add(
                    "zct-selected"
                );

                var selectedType =
                    card.getAttribute(
                        "data-contact-type"
                    );

                if (subjectField) {

                    subjectField.value =
                        selectedType;

                }


                var formSection =
                    document.getElementById(
                        "zct-form-section"
                    );

                if (formSection) {

                    formSection.scrollIntoView({
                        behavior: "smooth",
                        block: "start"
                    });

                }

            }
        );

    });


    /* =====================================
       CHARACTER COUNTER
       ===================================== */

    if (messageField) {

        messageField.addEventListener(
            "input",
            function () {

                if (countField) {

                    countField.textContent =
                        String(
                            messageField.value.length
                        );

                }

            }
        );

    }


    /* =====================================
       ERROR HELPERS
       ===================================== */

    function zctSetError(
        field,
        message
    ) {

        if (!field) {
            return;
        }

        var parent =
            field.parentElement;

        if (!parent) {
            return;
        }

        var error =
            parent.querySelector(
                ".zct-error"
            );

        field.style.borderColor =
            "rgba(255, 100, 100, .65)";

        if (error) {

            error.textContent =
                message;

        }

    }


    function zctClearError(field) {

        if (!field) {
            return;
        }

        var parent =
            field.parentElement;

        if (!parent) {
            return;
        }

        var error =
            parent.querySelector(
                ".zct-error"
            );

        field.style.borderColor = "";

        if (error) {

            error.textContent = "";

        }

    }


    function zctEmailValid(email) {

        var atPosition =
            email.indexOf("@");

        var dotPosition =
            email.lastIndexOf(".");

        if (atPosition < 1) {
            return false;
        }

        if (
            dotPosition <
            atPosition + 2
        ) {
            return false;
        }

        if (
            dotPosition ===
            email.length - 1
        ) {
            return false;
        }

        return true;

    }


    /* =====================================
       RESPONSE MESSAGE
       ===================================== */

    function zctShowResponse(
        type,
        message
    ) {

        if (!responseBox) {
            return;
        }

        responseBox.className =
            "zct-form-response " +
            type;

        responseBox.textContent =
            message;

    }


    /* =====================================
       SUBMIT BUTTON
       ===================================== */

    function zctSetSending(
        sending
    ) {

        if (!submitButton) {
            return;
        }

        if (sending) {

            submitButton.disabled =
                true;

            submitButton.textContent =
                "Sending...";

        } else {

            submitButton.disabled =
                false;

            submitButton.textContent =
                "Send message";

        }

    }


    /* =====================================
       FORM SUBMISSION
       ===================================== */

    if (contactForm) {

        contactForm.addEventListener(
            "submit",
            function (event) {

                event.preventDefault();


                var nameField =
                    document.getElementById(
                        "zct-name"
                    );

                var emailField =
                    document.getElementById(
                        "zct-email"
                    );


                if (!nameField) {
                    return;
                }

                if (!emailField) {
                    return;
                }

                if (!subjectField) {
                    return;
                }

                if (!messageField) {
                    return;
                }


                var valid = true;


                zctClearError(
                    nameField
                );

                zctClearError(
                    emailField
                );

                zctClearError(
                    subjectField
                );

                zctClearError(
                    messageField
                );


                var nameValue =
                    nameField.value.trim();

                var emailValue =
                    emailField.value.trim();

                var subjectValue =
                    subjectField.value;

                var messageValue =
                    messageField.value.trim();


                if (
                    nameValue.length < 2
                ) {

                    zctSetError(
                        nameField,
                        "Please enter your name."
                    );

                    valid = false;

                }


                if (
                    !zctEmailValid(
                        emailValue
                    )
                ) {

                    zctSetError(
                        emailField,
                        "Enter a valid email address."
                    );

                    valid = false;

                }


                if (!subjectValue) {

                    zctSetError(
                        subjectField,
                        "Choose a topic."
                    );

                    valid = false;

                }


                if (
                    messageValue.length < 10
                ) {

                    zctSetError(
                        messageField,
                        "Give us a little more detail."
                    );

                    valid = false;

                }


                if (!valid) {

                    if (responseBox) {

                        responseBox.className =
                            "zct-form-response";

                        responseBox.textContent =
                            "";

                    }

                    return;

                }


                /* =====================================
                   API PAYLOAD
                   ===================================== */

                var payload = {
                    name: nameValue,
                    email: emailValue,
                    subject: subjectValue,
                    message: messageValue
                };


                zctSetSending(true);


                zctShowResponse(
                    "zct-response-info",
                    "Sending your message..."
                );


                /* =====================================
                   API REQUEST
                   ===================================== */

                var request =
                    new XMLHttpRequest();


                request.open(
                    "POST",
                    "https://zevqyn-backend.onrender.com/api/v1/contact",
                    true
                );


                request.setRequestHeader(
                    "Content-Type",
                    "application/json"
                );


                request.onreadystatechange =
                    function () {

                        if (
                            request.readyState !== 4
                        ) {
                            return;
                        }


                        zctSetSending(false);


                        if (
                            request.status >= 200
                        ) {

                            if (
                                request.status < 300
                            ) {

                                zctShowResponse(
                                    "zct-response-success",
                                    "Message sent successfully! We'll get back to you soon."
                                );


                                contactForm.reset();


                                if (countField) {

                                    countField.textContent =
                                        "0";

                                }


                                typeCards.forEach(
                                    function (item) {

                                        item.classList.remove(
                                            "zct-selected"
                                        );

                                    }
                                );


                                return;

                            }

                        }


                        zctShowResponse(
                            "zct-response-error",
                            "We could not send your message. Please try again."
                        );

                    };


                request.onerror =
                    function () {

                        zctSetSending(false);

                        zctShowResponse(
                            "zct-response-error",
                            "We could not connect to ZEVQYN. Please try again."
                        );

                    };


                request.ontimeout =
                    function () {

                        zctSetSending(false);

                        zctShowResponse(
                            "zct-response-error",
                            "The request took too long. Please try again."
                        );

                    };


                request.timeout =
                    30000;


                request.send(
                    JSON.stringify(
                        payload
                    )
                );

            }
        );

    }


    /* =====================================
       FAQ
       ===================================== */

    var faqButtons =
        document.querySelectorAll(
            "#zev-contact-page .zct-faq-button"
        );


    faqButtons.forEach(
        function (button) {

            button.addEventListener(
                "click",
                function () {

                    var item =
                        button.parentElement;

                    if (!item) {
                        return;
                    }


                    var answer =
                        item.querySelector(
                            ".zct-faq-answer"
                        );


                    var wasOpen =
                        item.classList.contains(
                            "zct-open"
                        );


                    var allItems =
                        document.querySelectorAll(
                            "#zev-contact-page .zct-faq-item"
                        );


                    allItems.forEach(
                        function (faqItem) {

                            faqItem.classList.remove(
                                "zct-open"
                            );


                            var faqAnswer =
                                faqItem.querySelector(
                                    ".zct-faq-answer"
                                );


                            if (faqAnswer) {

                                faqAnswer.style.maxHeight =
                                    null;

                            }

                        }
                    );


                    if (wasOpen) {
                        return;
                    }


                    item.classList.add(
                        "zct-open"
                    );


                    if (answer) {

                        answer.style.maxHeight =
                            answer.scrollHeight +
                            "px";

                    }

                }
            );

        }
    );


    /* =====================================
       SCROLL REVEAL
       ===================================== */

    var revealItems =
        document.querySelectorAll(
            "#zev-contact-page .zct-reveal"
        );


    if (
        "IntersectionObserver" in window
    ) {

        var observer =
            new IntersectionObserver(
                function (entries) {

                    entries.forEach(
                        function (entry) {

                            if (
                                entry.isIntersecting
                            ) {

                                entry.target
                                    .classList
                                    .add(
                                        "zct-visible"
                                    );


                                observer.unobserve(
                                    entry.target
                                );

                            }

                        }
                    );

                },
                {
                    threshold: 0.08
                }
            );


        revealItems.forEach(
            function (item) {

                observer.observe(
                    item
                );

            }
        );

    } else {

        revealItems.forEach(
            function (item) {

                item.classList.add(
                    "zct-visible"
                );

            }
        );

    }

}


/* =====================================
   INITIALIZE
   ===================================== */

if (
    document.readyState ===
    "loading"
) {

    document.addEventListener(
        "DOMContentLoaded",
        function () {

            zevContactInitialize();

        }
    );

} else {

    zevContactInitialize();

}
</script>

<div id="zev-contact-page" class="zct-page">

    <!-- HERO -->
    <section class="zct-hero">
        <div class="zct-glow zct-glow-one"></div>
        <div class="zct-glow zct-glow-two"></div>

        <div class="zct-container zct-hero-grid">

            <div class="zct-hero-copy zct-reveal">

                    <span></span>
                    CONTACT ZEVQYN
                </div>

                <h1>
                    Got something<br>
                    <span>on your mind?</span>
                </h1>

                <p>
                    Need help, found something weird, have an idea,
                    or just want to talk about ZEVQYN?
                    You're in the right place.
                </p>

                    <div class="zct-note-arrow">↘</div>

                        <strong>Real messages only.</strong>

                    </div>
                </div>

            </div>


            <!-- HERO VISUAL -->

                <div class="zct-visual-inner">

                    <div class="zct-visual-top">

                        <div class="zct-online">
                            <i></i>
                            ZEVQYN
                        </div>
                    </div>

                    <div class="zct-message-window">

                            </p>

                        <div class="zct-message-zev">
                            <div class="zct-zev-avatar">Z</div>

                            <div>
                                <small>ZEVQYN</small>
                                <p>We're listening.</p>
                            </div>
                        </div>

                    </div>

                    <div class="zct-floating-tag zct-tag-one">
                        ✦ Feedback
                    </div>

                    <div class="zct-floating-tag zct-tag-two">
                        Support ↗
                    </div>

                    <div class="zct-hand-note">
                        good ideas start<br>
                        with a message ↗
                    </div>

                </div>

            </div>

        </div>
    </section>


    <!-- CONTACT TYPES -->
    <section class="zct-types">
        <div class="zct-container">

            <div class="zct-section-head zct-reveal">

                <div class="zct-section-label">
                    <span>01</span>
                    WHAT'S UP?
                </div>

                <h2>
                    Pick your <span>reason.</span>
                </h2>

                <p>
                    Whatever brought you here, point us in the right direction.
                </p>

            </div>


            <div class="zct-type-grid">

                <button type="button" class="zct-type-card zct-reveal" data-contact-type="Support">
                    <div class="zct-type-icon">?</div>

                    <div>
                        <strong>Need help</strong>

                    </div>

                    <i>↗</i>
                </button>


                <button type="button" class="zct-type-card zct-reveal" data-contact-type="Feedback">
                    <div class="zct-type-icon">✦</div>

                    <div>
                        <strong>Share feedback</strong>
                        <span>Tell us what you think.</span>
                    </div>

                    <i>↗</i>
                </button>


                <button type="button" class="zct-type-card zct-reveal" data-contact-type="Partnership">
                    <div class="zct-type-icon">◇</div>

                    <div>
                        <strong>Work together</strong>
                        <span>Partnership or collaboration.</span>
                    </div>

                    <i>↗</i>
                </button>


                <button type="button" class="zct-type-card zct-reveal" data-contact-type="Other">
                    <div class="zct-type-icon">→</div>

                    <div>
                        <strong>Something else</strong>
                        <span>We're still listening.</span>
                    </div>

                    <i>↗</i>
                </button>

            </div>

        </div>
    </section>


    <!-- CONTACT FORM -->
    <section id="zct-form-section" class="zct-contact">
        <div class="zct-container zct-contact-grid">

            <div class="zct-contact-copy zct-reveal">

                <div class="zct-section-label">
                    <span>02</span>
                    SEND A MESSAGE
                </div>

                <h2>
                    Tell us what's<br>
                    <span>going on.</span>
                </h2>

                <p>
                    Give us enough detail to understand what you need.
                    Screenshots, error messages and dramatic backstories
                    are all welcome.
                </p>


                <div class="zct-contact-points">

                    <div>
                        <span>01</span>

                        <div>
                            <strong>Keep it clear</strong>
                            <p>Tell us what happened or what you're thinking.</p>
                        </div>
                    </div>

                    <div>
                        <span>02</span>

                        <div>
                            <strong>Add useful details</strong>
                            <p>
                                For bugs, mention what you were doing
                                when it happened.
                            </p>
                        </div>
                    </div>

                    <div>
                        <span>03</span>

                        <div>
                            <strong>Hit send</strong>
                            <p>That's it. No maze of support menus.</p>
                        </div>
                    </div>

                </div>


                <div class="zct-side-note">
                    <span>↳</span>
                    humans appreciate context too.
                </div>

            </div>


            <div class="zct-form-shell zct-running-border zct-reveal">

                <div class="zct-form-inner">

                    <div class="zct-form-heading">

                        <div>
                            <small>CONTACT FORM</small>
                            <h3>Let's talk.</h3>
                        </div>

                        <div class="zct-form-status">
                            <i></i>
                            READY
                        </div>

                    </div>


                    <form id="zct-contact-form" novalidate="">

                        <div class="zct-form-row">

                            <div class="zct-field">
                                <label for="zct-name">
                                    Your name
                                </label>

                                <input id="zct-name" name="name" type="text" placeholder="What should we call you?" autocomplete="name">

                                <small class="zct-error"></small>

                            <div class="zct-field">
                                <label for="zct-email">

                                <small class="zct-error"></small>
                            </div>

                        </div>


                        <div class="zct-field">

                            <label for="zct-subject">
                                What's this about?
                            </label>

                            <select id="zct-subject" name="subject">
                                <option value="">
                                    Choose a topic
                                </option>

                                <option value="Support">
                                    I need help
                                </option>

                                <option value="Feedback">
                                    Feedback / suggestion
                                </option>

                                <option value="Partnership">
                                    Partnership / collaboration
                                </option>

                                <option value="Bug">
                                    Report a bug
                                </option>

                                <option value="Other">
                                    Something else
                                </option>
                            </select>

                            <small class="zct-error"></small>

                        </div>


                        <div class="zct-field">

                            <label for="zct-message">
                                Message
                            </label>

                            <textarea id="zct-message" name="message" rows="7" maxlength="1500" placeholder="Tell us what's on your mind..."></textarea>

                            <div class="zct-message-meta">
                                <small class="zct-error"></small>

                                <span>
                                    <b id="zct-count">0</b>/1500
                                </span>
                            </div>

                        </div>


                        <button type="submit" class="zct-submit" id="zct-submit">
                            <span>Send message</span>
                            <i>↗</i>
                        </button>


                        <div id="zct-form-response" class="zct-form-response" aria-live="polite"></div>

                    </form>

                </div>

            </div>

        </div>
    </section>


    <!-- QUICK HELP -->
    <section class="zct-help">
        <div class="zct-container">

            <div class="zct-section-head zct-reveal">

                <div class="zct-section-label">
                    <span>03</span>
                    BEFORE YOU SEND
                </div>

                <h2>
                    Maybe the answer is<br>
                    <span>already here.</span>
                </h2>

            </div>


            <div class="zct-help-grid">

                <a href="/features/" class="zct-help-card zct-reveal">
                    <span>01</span>
                    <div>
                        <strong>Explore Features</strong>
                        <p>
                            See what you can actually do inside ZEVQYN.
                        </p>
                    </div>
                    <i>↗</i>
                </a>


                <a href="/how-it-works/" class="zct-help-card zct-reveal">
                    <span>02</span>
                    <div>
                        <strong>How It Works</strong>
                        <p>
                            Follow the full research-to-career workflow.
                        </p>
                    </div>
                    <i>↗</i>
                </a>


                <a href="/about/" class="zct-help-card zct-reveal">
                    <span>03</span>
                    <div>
                        <strong>About ZEVQYN</strong>
                        <p>
                            Find out why we're building this.
                        </p>
                    </div>
                    <i>↗</i>
                </a>

            </div>

        </div>
    </section>


    <!-- FAQ -->
    <section class="zct-faq">
        <div class="zct-container zct-faq-grid">

            <div class="zct-faq-copy zct-reveal">

                <div class="zct-section-label">
                    <span>04</span>
                    QUICK ANSWERS
                </div>

                <h2>
                    Tiny FAQ.<br>
                    <span>Big questions welcome.</span>
                </h2>

                <p>
                    Didn't find what you needed?
                    That's what the form above is for.
                </p>

            </div>


            <div class="zct-accordion">

                <div class="zct-faq-item zct-reveal">

                    <button type="button" class="zct-faq-button">
                        <span>What is ZEVQYN?</span>
                        <i>+</i>
                    </button>

                    <div class="zct-faq-answer">
                        <p>
                            ZEVQYN is an AI-powered research and career
                            workspace that connects research, projects,
                            career information, resumes, portfolios and
                            AI career guidance.
                        </p>
                    </div>

                </div>


                <div class="zct-faq-item zct-reveal">

                    <button type="button" class="zct-faq-button">
                        <span>Who is ZEVQYN built for?</span>
                        <i>+</i>
                    </button>

                    <div class="zct-faq-answer">
                        <p>
                            It's designed around students, developers,
                            self-learners and people building toward
                            internships or early career opportunities.
                        </p>
                    </div>

                </div>


                <div class="zct-faq-item zct-reveal">

                    <button type="button" class="zct-faq-button">
                        <span>Can I report a bug here?</span>
                        <i>+</i>
                    </button>

                    <div class="zct-faq-answer">
                        <p>
                            Yes. Choose “Report a bug” in the contact form
                            and include what happened, what you expected,
                            and any useful error details.
                        </p>
                    </div>

                </div>


                <div class="zct-faq-item zct-reveal">

                    <button type="button" class="zct-faq-button">
                        <span>Can I suggest a feature?</span>
                        <i>+</i>
                    </button>

                    <div class="zct-faq-answer">
                        <p>
                            Absolutely. Choose the feedback option and
                            explain the idea, why you'd use it, and what
                            problem it would solve for you.
                        </p>
                    </div>

                </div>

            </div>

        </div>
    </section>


    <!-- FINAL CTA -->
    <section class="zct-final">
        <div class="zct-container">

            <div class="zct-final-card zct-running-border zct-reveal">

                <div class="zct-final-inner">

                    <div class="zct-final-icon">✦</div>

                    <div>
                        <small>NOT HERE FOR SUPPORT?</small>

                        <h2>
                            Maybe you're ready to<br>
                            <span>build something instead.</span>
                        </h2>

                        <p>
                            Start your ZEVQYN workspace and turn
                            what you're learning into work worth showing.
                        </p>
                    </div>

                    <a href="/register/" class="zct-btn zct-btn-primary zct-final-btn">
                        Start with ZEVQYN
                        <span>↗</span>
                    </a>

                </div>

            </div>

        </div>
    </section>

</div>

item.title: Privacy Policy
item.dc:creator: hussnain
item.content:encoded:
Who we are

Suggested text: Our website address is: https://startersites.io/blocksy/codespot.

Comments

Suggested text: When visitors leave comments on the site we collect the data shown in the comments form, and also the visitor’s IP address and browser user agent string to help spam detection.

An anonymized string created from your email address (also called a hash) may be provided to the Gravatar service to see if you are using it. The Gravatar service privacy policy is available here: https://automattic.com/privacy/. After approval of your comment, your profile picture is visible to the public in the context of your comment.

Media

Suggested text: If you upload images to the website, you should avoid uploading images with embedded location data (EXIF GPS) included. Visitors to the website can download and extract any location data from images on the website.

Cookies

Suggested text: If you leave a comment on our site you may opt-in to saving your name, email address and website in cookies. These are for your convenience so that you do not have to fill in your details again when you leave another comment. These cookies will last for one year.

If you visit our login page, we will set a temporary cookie to determine if your browser accepts cookies. This cookie contains no personal data and is discarded when you close your browser.

When you log in, we will also set up several cookies to save your login information and your screen display choices. Login cookies last for two days, and screen options cookies last for a year. If you select "Remember Me", your login will persist for two weeks. If you log out of your account, the login cookies will be removed.

If you edit or publish an article, an additional cookie will be saved in your browser. This cookie includes no personal data and simply indicates the post ID of the article you just edited. It expires after 1 day.

Embedded content from other websites

Suggested text: Articles on this site may include embedded content (e.g. videos, images, articles, etc.). Embedded content from other websites behaves in the exact same way as if the visitor has visited the other website.

These websites may collect data about you, use cookies, embed additional third-party tracking, and monitor your interaction with that embedded content, including tracking your interaction with the embedded content if you have an account and are logged in to that website.

Who we share your data with

Suggested text: If you request a password reset, your IP address will be included in the reset email.

How long we retain your data

Suggested text: If you leave a comment, the comment and its metadata are retained indefinitely. This is so we can recognize and approve any follow-up comments automatically instead of holding them in a moderation queue.

For users that register on our website (if any), we also store the personal information they provide in their user profile. All users can see, edit, or delete their personal information at any time (except they cannot change their username). Website administrators can also see and edit that information.

What rights you have over your data

Suggested text: If you have an account on this site, or have left comments, you can request to receive an exported file of the personal data we hold about you, including any data you have provided to us. You can also request that we erase any personal data we hold about you. This does not include any data we are obliged to keep for administrative, legal, or security purposes.

Where your data is sent

Suggested text: Visitor comments may be checked through an automated spam detection service.

item.title: Features
item.dc:creator: hussnain
item.content:encoded:
<!-- wp:html -->
<style data-wp-block-html="css">
/* Hide default Blocksy page title */
.hero-section {
    display: none !important;
}

.entry-header {
    display: none !important;
}

.hero-section,
.entry-header {
    display: none !important;
}

#zev-genz-features,
#zev-genz-features * {
    box-sizing: border-box;
}

#zev-genz-features {
    --green: #35d875;
    --green2: #62f69a;
    --bg: #020504;
    --panel: #07100d;
    --panel2: #091411;
    --border: #173128;
    --text: #f6faf8;
    --muted: #8ba099;

    width: 100%;
    overflow: hidden;
    background: var(--bg);
    color: var(--text);

    font-family: Inter, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont,
        "Segoe UI", sans-serif;
}

.zgf-container {
    width: min(1180px, calc(100% - 44px));
    margin: 0 auto;
}

.zgf-hero {
    position: relative;
    padding: 95px 0 110px;
    background:
        radial-gradient(circle at 75% 40%, rgba(31, 168, 86, .16), transparent 30%),
        radial-gradient(circle at 25% 0%, rgba(35, 103, 76, .08), transparent 30%);
}

.zgf-hero::before {
    content: "";
    position: absolute;
    inset: 0;
    opacity: .2;
    pointer-events: none;

    background-image:
        linear-gradient(rgba(75, 125, 102, .08) 1px, transparent 1px),
        linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(75, 125, 102, .08) 1px, transparent 1px);

    background-size: 70px 70px;
    mask-image: linear-gradient(to bottom, #000, transparent);
}

.zgf-hero-grid {
    position: relative;
    z-index: 2;

    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: .92fr 1.08fr;
    gap: 70px;
    align-items: center;
}

.zgf-hand-note {
    margin-bottom: 15px;
    color: #c8d8d1;
    font-size: 17px;
    font-style: italic;
    transform: rotate(-2deg);
}

.zgf-hero h1 {
    margin: 0 0 22px;

    font-size: clamp(52px, 6vw, 82px);
    line-height: .96;
    letter-spacing: -.055em;
    font-weight: 850;
}

.zgf-hero h1 span,
.zgf-heading h2 span,
.zgf-workflow-copy h2 span,
.zgf-genz-copy h2 span,
.zgf-ai-copy h2 span,
.zgf-final-copy h2 span {
    color: var(--green);
}

.zgf-hero-copy > p {
    max-width: 580px;
    margin: 0;
    color: var(--muted);
    font-size: 16px;
    line-height: 1.75;
}

.zgf-actions {
    display: flex;
    flex-wrap: wrap;
    gap: 11px;
    margin-top: 30px;
}

.zgf-btn {
    min-height: 48px;
    padding: 0 20px;

    display: inline-flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    gap: 10px;

    border-radius: 8px;

    text-decoration: none !important;
    font-size: 12px;
    font-weight: 800;

    transition: .2s ease;
}

.zgf-btn:hover {
    transform: translateY(-2px);
}

.zgf-primary {
    background: var(--green);
    border: 1px solid var(--green);
    color: #03190b !important;
}

.zgf-secondary {
    background: #07100d;
    border: 1px solid #294038;
    color: #dbe6e1 !important;
}

.zgf-mini-proof {
    margin-top: 34px;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 13px;
}

.zgf-avatar-stack {
    display: flex;
}

.zgf-avatar-stack span {
    width: 30px;
    height: 30px;
    margin-left: -6px;

    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;

    border: 2px solid #030706;
    border-radius: 50%;

    background: #10231b;
    color: var(--green);
    font-size: 9px;
    font-weight: 900;
}

.zgf-avatar-stack span:first-child {
    margin-left: 0;
}

.zgf-mini-proof p {
    margin: 0;
    color: #758b82;
    font-size: 10px;
    line-height: 1.5;
}


/* HERO VISUAL */

.zgf-hero-visual {
    position: relative;
    min-height: 500px;
}

.zgf-laptop {
    position: absolute;
    width: 480px;
    max-width: 82%;
    left: 48%;
    top: 50%;
    transform: translate(-50%, -50%) rotate(-2deg);

    overflow: hidden;

    border: 2px solid #1e4032;
    border-radius: 18px;

    background: #050b09;

    box-shadow:
        0 40px 90px rgba(0, 0, 0, .55),
        0 0 60px rgba(43, 211, 112, .08);
}

.zgf-laptop-top {
    height: 43px;
    padding: 0 15px;

    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 8px;

    border-bottom: 1px solid #163026;
}

.zgf-logo-dot {
    width: 22px;
    height: 22px;

    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;

    border-radius: 6px;
    background: var(--green);
    color: #06160c;

    font-size: 9px;
    font-weight: 900;
}

.zgf-laptop-top > span {
    font-size: 9px;
    font-weight: 800;
}

.zgf-laptop-top i {
    width: 6px;
    height: 6px;
    margin-left: auto;

    border-radius: 50%;
    background: var(--green);
}

.zgf-laptop-content {
    padding: 32px;
}

.zgf-laptop-content > small {
    color: #537066;
    font-size: 8px;
    letter-spacing: .14em;
}

.zgf-laptop-content h3 {
    margin: 12px 0 25px;
    font-size: 28px;
    line-height: 1.08;
}

.zgf-laptop-content h3 span {
    color: var(--green);
}

.zgf-dashboard-row {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr);
    gap: 8px;
}

.zgf-dashboard-row div {
    padding: 14px;
    border: 1px solid #173128;
    border-radius: 8px;
    background: #08110e;
}

.zgf-dashboard-row strong,
.zgf-dashboard-row span {
    display: block;
}

.zgf-dashboard-row strong {
    color: var(--green);
    font-size: 18px;
}

.zgf-dashboard-row span {
    margin-top: 3px;
    color: #71877e;
    font-size: 8px;
}

.zgf-screen-card {
    margin-top: 10px;
    padding: 15px;

    display: flex;
    gap: 11px;
    align-items: center;

    border: 1px solid rgba(53, 216, 117, .3);
    border-radius: 8px;

    background: rgba(53, 216, 117, .06);
}

.zgf-screen-card > span {
    color: var(--green);
}

.zgf-screen-card div {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
}

.zgf-screen-card strong {
    font-size: 10px;
}

.zgf-screen-card small {
    color: #70867d;
    font-size: 8px;
}

.zgf-floating-card {
    position: absolute;
    z-index: 3;

    padding: 9px 12px;

    border: 1px solid #234538;
    border-radius: 8px;

    background: rgba(5, 14, 10, .94);

    color: #bdcec7;
    font-size: 9px;

    box-shadow: 0 15px 35px rgba(0,0,0,.35);
}

.zgf-floating-card span {
    color: var(--green);
    margin-right: 5px;
}

.zgf-float-one {
    top: 100px;
    left: 0;
}

.zgf-float-two {
    right: 0;
    bottom: 95px;
}

.zgf-doodle {
    position: absolute;
    z-index: 4;

    color: #d9e3df;

    font-size: 15px;
    font-style: italic;
    line-height: 1.25;
}

.zgf-doodle strong {
    color: var(--green);
}

.zgf-doodle-top {
    right: 5px;
    top: 10px;

.zgf-desk-scene {

/* =====================================================
   ZEVQYN — RUNNING GREEN LIGHT AROUND VISUALS
   ===================================================== */

/* Apply the effect to all major visual/image containers */
.zgf-laptop,
.zgf-desk-scene,
.zgf-phone,
.zgf-career-ai,
.zgf-final-box {
    position: relative;
    isolation: isolate;
    overflow: hidden;

    /* Remove normal border so animated border can show */
    border: 1px solid transparent !important;

    background:
        linear-gradient(#07100d, #07100d) padding-box,
        conic-gradient(
            from var(--zev-angle),
            transparent 0deg,
            transparent 300deg,
            rgba(53, 216, 117, 0.10) 315deg,
            rgba(53, 216, 117, 0.55) 330deg,
            #35d875 344deg,
            #9dffc0 351deg,
            #35d875 357deg,
            transparent 360deg
        ) border-box;

    animation: zev-running-border 4s linear infinite;
}


/* Allows the conic gradient angle to animate smoothly */
@property --zev-angle {
    syntax: "<angle>";
    initial-value: 0deg;
    inherits: false;
}


/* Rotate ONLY the border light */
@keyframes zev-running-border {
    from {
        --zev-angle: 0deg;
    }

    to {
        --zev-angle: 360deg;
    }
}

<script data-wp-block-html="js">
function zevFeaturesInitialize() {

    var featureLinks =
        document.querySelectorAll(
            '#zev-genz-features a[href^="#"]'
        );

    featureLinks.forEach(
        function (link) {

            link.addEventListener(
                "click",
                function (event) {

                    var targetId =
                        link.getAttribute("href");

                    var target =
                        document.querySelector(targetId);

                    if (!target) {
                        return;
                    }

                    event.preventDefault();

                    target.scrollIntoView({
                        behavior: "smooth",
                        block: "start"
                    });
                }
            );
        }

    var revealItems =
        document.querySelectorAll(
            "#zev-genz-features .zgf-feature-card, " +
            "#zev-genz-features .zgf-step, " +
            "#zev-genz-features .zgf-ai-tool-grid > div"
        );


    revealItems.forEach(
        function (item) {
            item.classList.add("zgf-reveal");
        }
    );


    if ("IntersectionObserver" in window) {

        var observer =
            new IntersectionObserver(
                function (entries) {

                    entries.forEach(
                        function (entry) {

                            if (entry.isIntersecting) {

                                entry.target.classList.add(
                                    "zgf-visible"

                                observer.unobserve(
                                    entry.target
                                );
                            }
                        }

                {
                    threshold: 0.08
                }
            );


        revealItems.forEach(
            function (item) {
                observer.observe(item);
            }
        );

    } else {

        revealItems.forEach(
            function (item) {
                item.classList.add("zgf-visible");
