item.dc:creator: hussnain
item.content:encoded:
<!-- wp:html -->
<style data-wp-block-html="css">
/* =========================================================
   HIDE WORDPRESS PAGE TITLE
   ========================================================= */

.hero-section,
.entry-header {
    display: none !important;
}


/* =========================================================
   BASE
   ========================================================= */

#zev-how-page,
#zev-how-page * {
    box-sizing: border-box;
}

#zev-how-page {
    --green: #35dc78;
    --green-bright: #8effb5;
    --background: #020504;
    --panel: #06100c;
    --panel-2: #08140f;
    --border: #173328;
    --text: #f7faf8;
    --muted: #81968d;

    width: 100%;
    overflow: hidden;

    background: var(--background);
    color: var(--text);

    font-family:
        Inter,
        -apple-system,
        BlinkMacSystemFont,
        "Segoe UI",
        sans-serif;
}

.zhi-container {
    width: min(1180px, calc(100% - 44px));
    margin: 0 auto;
}

.zhi-kicker {
    margin-bottom: 13px;

    color: var(--green);

    font-size: 10px;
    font-weight: 850;
    letter-spacing: .16em;
}

.zhi-btn {
    min-height: 49px;
    padding: 0 21px;

    display: inline-flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    gap: 10px;

    border-radius: 8px;

    font-size: 12px;
    font-weight: 800;

    text-decoration: none !important;

    transition:
        transform .2s ease,
        box-shadow .2s ease;
}

.zhi-btn:hover {
    transform: translateY(-2px);
}

.zhi-btn-primary {
    color: #03180b !important;
    background: var(--green);

    box-shadow:
        0 12px 35px rgba(53, 220, 120, .13);
}

.zhi-btn-secondary {
    color: #dbe8e2 !important;

    border: 1px solid #294139;

    background: #07100d;
}


/* =========================================================
   HERO
   ========================================================= */

.zhi-hero {
    position: relative;

    min-height: 720px;
    padding: 105px 0 100px;

    display: flex;
    align-items: center;

    background:
        radial-gradient(
            circle at 75% 40%,
            rgba(45, 211, 111, .12),
            transparent 28%
        ),
        radial-gradient(
            circle at 15% 20%,
            rgba(71, 66, 255, .07),
            transparent 28%
        );
}

.zhi-hero::before {
    content: "";

    position: absolute;
    inset: 0;

    opacity: .18;

    background-image:
        linear-gradient(
            rgba(74, 123, 102, .09) 1px,
            transparent 1px
        ),
        linear-gradient(
            90deg,
            rgba(74, 123, 102, .09) 1px,
            transparent 1px
        );

    background-size: 65px 65px;

    mask-image:
        linear-gradient(
            to bottom,
            #000,
            transparent 95%
        );

    pointer-events: none;
}

.zhi-hero > .zhi-container {
    position: relative;
    z-index: 2;

    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: .9fr 1.1fr;

    gap: 70px;
    align-items: center;
}

.zhi-hero-content h1 {
    margin: 0 0 24px;

    font-size: clamp(54px, 6vw, 82px);
    line-height: .96;

    letter-spacing: -.055em;
    font-weight: 850;
}

.zhi-hero-content h1 span {
    color: var(--green);
}

.zhi-hero-content > p {
    max-width: 550px;

    margin: 0;

    color: var(--muted);

    font-size: 16px;
    line-height: 1.75;
}

.zhi-hero-actions {
    margin-top: 30px;

    display: flex;
    flex-wrap: wrap;

    gap: 10px;
}


/* =========================================================
   HERO MAP
   ========================================================= */

.zhi-hero-map {
    position: relative;

    width: 100%;
    height: 520px;
}

.zhi-orbit {
    position: absolute;

    width: 360px;
    height: 360px;

    left: 50%;
    top: 50%;

    transform:
        translate(-50%, -50%)
        rotate(-10deg);

    border: 1px dashed rgba(53, 220, 120, .25);
    border-radius: 50%;

    animation:
        zhiOrbitSpin 30s linear infinite;
}

.zhi-core {
    position: absolute;

    width: 180px;
    height: 180px;

    left: 50%;
    top: 50%;

    transform: translate(-50%, -50%);

    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;

    border: 1px solid #28533f;
    border-radius: 50%;

    background:
        radial-gradient(
            circle,
            rgba(53, 220, 120, .12),
            #06100c 70%
        );

    box-shadow:
        0 0 80px rgba(53, 220, 120, .09);
}

.zhi-core-logo {
    width: 45px;
    height: 45px;

    margin-bottom: 9px;

    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;

    border-radius: 12px;

    background: var(--green);
    color: #03170a;

    font-weight: 900;
}

.zhi-core strong {
    font-size: 16px;
}

.zhi-core span {
    margin-top: 5px;

    color: #688077;
    font-size: 8px;
}

.zhi-node {
    position: absolute;

    min-width: 110px;
    padding: 13px 15px;

    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 8px;

    border: 1px solid #1d4032;
    border-radius: 9px;

    background: rgba(5, 15, 11, .94);

    box-shadow:
        0 15px 35px rgba(0, 0, 0, .35);
}

.zhi-node i {
    color: var(--green);

    font-size: 7px;
    font-style: normal;
}

.zhi-node strong {
    font-size: 10px;
}

.zhi-node-1 {
    left: 5%;
    top: 16%;
}

.zhi-node-2 {
    right: 5%;
    top: 15%;
}

.zhi-node-3 {
    right: 0;
    top: 48%;
}

.zhi-node-4 {
    right: 8%;
    bottom: 10%;
}

.zhi-node-5 {
    left: 7%;
    bottom: 10%;
}

.zhi-node-6 {
    left: 0;
    top: 48%;
}

.zhi-map-label {
    position: absolute;

    right: 0;
    top: 0;

    color: #d6e0dc;

    font-size: 15px;
    font-style: italic;

    transform: rotate(3deg);
}

.zhi-map-label span {
    color: var(--green);
}

.zhi-floating-note {
    position: absolute;

    left: 50%;
    bottom: 0;

    transform:
        translateX(-50%)
        rotate(-2deg);

    color: var(--green);

    font-size: 12px;
    font-style: italic;
}


/* =========================================================
   GENERAL SECTIONS
   ========================================================= */

.zhi-section,
.zhi-step-section {
    padding: 110px 0;

    border-top:
        1px solid rgba(65, 111, 91, .12);
}

.zhi-section-heading {
    max-width: 720px;

    margin-bottom: 55px;
}

.zhi-center {
    margin-left: auto;
    margin-right: auto;

    text-align: center;
}

.zhi-section-heading h2,
.zhi-step-copy h2,
.zhi-final-card h2 {
    margin: 0 0 17px;

    font-size: clamp(36px, 4.4vw, 55px);
    line-height: 1.04;

    letter-spacing: -.045em;
}

.zhi-section-heading h2 span,
.zhi-step-copy h2 span,
.zhi-final-card h2 span {
    color: var(--green);
}

.zhi-section-heading p,
.zhi-step-copy > p,
.zhi-final-card > p {
    margin: 0;

    color: var(--muted);

    font-size: 14px;
    line-height: 1.75;
}


/* =========================================================
   FLOW STRIP
   ========================================================= */

.zhi-flow-strip {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;

    gap: 12px;
}

.zhi-flow-item {
    width: 155px;
    min-height: 135px;

    position: relative;

    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;

    border: 1px solid var(--border);
    border-radius: 12px;

    background: #07100d;
}

.zhi-flow-item b {
    position: absolute;

    left: 12px;
    top: 10px;

    color: #48645a;

    font-size: 7px;
}

.zhi-flow-item i {
    margin-bottom: 10px;

    color: var(--green);

    font-size: 22px;
    font-style: normal;
}

.zhi-flow-item strong {
    font-size: 10px;
}

.zhi-flow-arrow {
    color: #345348;

    font-size: 20px;
}


/* =========================================================
   STEP LAYOUT
   ========================================================= */

.zhi-alt {
    background:
        linear-gradient(
            180deg,
            rgba(6, 15, 11, .65),
            rgba(2, 5, 4, 0)
        );
}

.zhi-step-grid {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: .9fr 1.1fr;

    gap: 85px;
    align-items: center;
}

.zhi-reverse {
    grid-template-columns: 1.1fr .9fr;
}

.zhi-step-number {
    margin-bottom: 17px;

    color: rgba(53, 220, 120, .22);

    font-size: 54px;
    line-height: 1;

    font-weight: 900;
    letter-spacing: -.06em;
}

.zhi-points {
    margin-top: 28px;

    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;

    gap: 11px;
}

.zhi-points div {
    color: #a6b7b0;

    font-size: 11px;
}

.zhi-points i {
    width: 20px;
    height: 20px;

    margin-right: 8px;

    display: inline-flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;

    border-radius: 50%;

    background: rgba(53, 220, 120, .08);
    color: var(--green);

    font-size: 8px;
    font-style: normal;
}

.zhi-hand-note {
    display: inline-block;

    margin-top: 30px;

    color: #cad6d1;

    font-size: 13px;
    font-style: italic;

    transform: rotate(-2deg);
}


/* =========================================================
   RUNNING BORDER VISUALS
   ========================================================= */

@property --zhi-angle {
    syntax: "<angle>";
    initial-value: 0deg;
    inherits: false;
}

.zhi-visual,
.zhi-showcase,
.zhi-final-card {
    position: relative;

    isolation: isolate;
    overflow: hidden;

    border: 1px solid transparent;

    background:
        linear-gradient(
            #07100d,
            #07100d
        ) padding-box,

        conic-gradient(
            from var(--zhi-angle),
            transparent 0deg,
            transparent 302deg,
            rgba(53, 220, 120, .08) 315deg,
            rgba(53, 220, 120, .45) 330deg,
            var(--green) 344deg,
            var(--green-bright) 351deg,
            var(--green) 357deg,
            transparent 360deg
        ) border-box;

    animation:
        zhiRunningBorder 4s linear infinite;

    box-shadow:
        0 25px 65px rgba(0, 0, 0, .32);
}

@keyframes zhiRunningBorder {
    from {
        --zhi-angle: 0deg;
    }

    to {
        --zhi-angle: 360deg;
    }
}


/* =========================================================
   RESEARCH VISUAL
   ========================================================= */

.zhi-research-visual {
    min-height: 440px;

    border-radius: 17px;
}

.zhi-window-bar {
    height: 45px;

    padding: 0 15px;

    display: flex;
    align-items: center;

    gap: 6px;

    border-bottom: 1px solid #173027;
}

.zhi-window-bar > span {
    width: 7px;
    height: 7px;

    border-radius: 50%;

    background: #284137;
}

.zhi-window-bar > span:first-child {
    background: var(--green);
}

.zhi-window-bar small {
    margin-left: 8px;

    color: #667c73;

    font-size: 8px;
}

.zhi-window-body {
    min-height: 390px;

    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: 65px 1fr;
}

.zhi-mini-sidebar {
    padding: 22px 0;

    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    align-items: center;

    gap: 24px;

    border-right: 1px solid #173027;
}

.zhi-mini-sidebar b {
    width: 28px;
    height: 28px;

    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;

    border-radius: 7px;

    background: var(--green);
    color: #04170b;

    font-size: 10px;
}

.zhi-mini-sidebar i {
    color: #628076;

    font-size: 11px;
    font-style: normal;
}

.zhi-research-content {
    padding: 38px;
}

.zhi-research-content > small {
    color: var(--green);

    font-size: 7px;
    letter-spacing: .16em;
}

.zhi-research-content h3 {
    margin: 10px 0 7px;

    font-size: 23px;
}

.zhi-research-content > p {
    margin: 0 0 28px;

    color: #71877e;

    font-size: 10px;
}

.zhi-document {
    margin-top: 10px;
    padding: 13px;

    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: auto 1fr auto;

    gap: 12px;
    align-items: center;

    border: 1px solid #19362b;
    border-radius: 8px;

    background: #09130f;
}

.zhi-document > span {
    padding: 6px;

    border-radius: 5px;

    background: rgba(53, 220, 120, .08);
    color: var(--green);

    font-size: 7px;
    font-weight: 800;
}

.zhi-document div {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
}

.zhi-document strong {
    font-size: 9px;
}

.zhi-document small {
    margin-top: 3px;

    color: #63786f;

    font-size: 7px;
}

.zhi-document > b {
    color: var(--green);

    font-size: 10px;
}

.zhi-floating-chip {
    position: absolute;

    padding: 10px 13px;

    border: 1px solid #28523f;
    border-radius: 8px;

    background: #06100c;

    color: var(--green);

    font-size: 9px;

    box-shadow:
        0 15px 30px rgba(0, 0, 0, .35);
}

.zhi-chip-one {
    right: 18px;
    bottom: 18px;
}


/* =========================================================
   AI VISUAL
   ========================================================= */

.zhi-ai-visual {
    min-height: 430px;

    padding: 25px;

    border-radius: 17px;
}

.zhi-ai-top {
    padding-bottom: 17px;

    display: flex;
    align-items: center;

    gap: 9px;

    border-bottom: 1px solid #173027;

    font-size: 11px;
    font-weight: 750;
}

.zhi-ai-top > span {
    color: var(--green);
}

.zhi-ai-top i {
    margin-left: auto;

    color: var(--green);

    font-size: 7px;
    font-style: normal;
}

.zhi-chat {
    padding: 30px 5px;
}

.zhi-user-message {
    max-width: 75%;

    margin-left: auto;
    padding: 13px 15px;

    border-radius: 12px 12px 3px 12px;

    background: #112019;
    color: #c8d6d0;

    font-size: 9px;
    line-height: 1.6;
}

.zhi-ai-message {
    max-width: 88%;

    margin-top: 20px;

    display: flex;

    gap: 11px;
}

.zhi-ai-avatar {
    width: 30px;
    height: 30px;

    flex: 0 0 auto;

    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;

    border-radius: 8px;

    background: rgba(53, 220, 120, .1);
    color: var(--green);
}

.zhi-ai-message strong {
    font-size: 9px;
}

.zhi-ai-message p {
    margin: 6px 0 9px;

    color: #82968e;

    font-size: 9px;
    line-height: 1.65;
}

.zhi-source {
    display: inline-block;

    padding: 6px 8px;

    border-radius: 5px;

    background: #0b1a14;
    color: var(--green);

    font-size: 6px;
}

.zhi-ai-tools {
    position: absolute;

    left: 25px;
    right: 25px;
    bottom: 25px;

    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr);

    gap: 7px;
}

.zhi-ai-tools span {
    padding: 10px 5px;

    border: 1px solid #173328;
    border-radius: 7px;

    background: #08130f;

    color: #80958c;

    font-size: 7px;
    text-align: center;
}


/* =========================================================
   PROJECT VISUAL
   ========================================================= */

.zhi-project-visual {
    min-height: 450px;

    padding: 34px;

    border-radius: 17px;
}

.zhi-project-top {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;

    gap: 8px;

    color: var(--green);
}

.zhi-project-top small {
    font-size: 7px;
    letter-spacing: .14em;
}

.zhi-project-visual h3 {
    margin: 30px 0 9px;

    font-size: 29px;
}

.zhi-project-visual > p {
    max-width: 420px;

    color: #81958d;

    font-size: 10px;
    line-height: 1.65;
}

.zhi-project-label {
    margin-top: 28px;

    color: #60756c;

    font-size: 7px;
    letter-spacing: .13em;
}

.zhi-project-list {
    margin-top: 10px;

    display: flex;
    flex-wrap: wrap;

    gap: 7px;
}

.zhi-project-list span {
    padding: 8px 10px;

    border: 1px solid #1c3c30;
    border-radius: 6px;

    color: #a6b7b0;

    font-size: 7px;
}

.zhi-project-bottom {
    position: absolute;

    left: 34px;
    right: 34px;
    bottom: 30px;

    padding-top: 18px;

    display: flex;
    align-items: center;

    border-top: 1px solid #173027;
}

.zhi-project-bottom div {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
}

.zhi-project-bottom small {
    color: #60756c;

    font-size: 6px;
}

.zhi-project-bottom strong {
    margin-top: 4px;

    font-size: 8px;
}

.zhi-project-bottom button {
    margin-left: auto;
    padding: 10px 13px;

    border: 0;
    border-radius: 7px;

    background: var(--green);
    color: #04180b;

    font-size: 8px;
    font-weight: 850;
}

.zhi-sticker {
    position: absolute;

    right: 25px;
    top: 28px;

    color: #d7e0dc;

    font-size: 11px;
    font-style: italic;

    text-align: right;

    transform: rotate(4deg);
}

.zhi-sticker strong {
    color: var(--green);
}


/* =========================================================
   CAREER HUB VISUAL
   ========================================================= */

.zhi-career-visual {
    min-height: 430px;

    padding: 30px;

    border-radius: 17px;
}

.zhi-profile-head {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;

    gap: 12px;
}

.zhi-profile-avatar {
    width: 43px;
    height: 43px;

    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;

    border-radius: 50%;

    background: var(--green);
    color: #04170b;

    font-size: 13px;
    font-weight: 900;
}

.zhi-profile-head > div:nth-child(2) {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
}

.zhi-profile-head strong {
    font-size: 11px;
}

.zhi-profile-head span {
    margin-top: 3px;

    color: #698077;

    font-size: 8px;
}

.zhi-profile-head > b {
    margin-left: auto;

    color: var(--green);

    font-size: 20px;
}

.zhi-profile-progress {
    height: 5px;

    margin: 20px 0 28px;

    overflow: hidden;

    border-radius: 20px;

    background: #102019;
}

.zhi-profile-progress span {
    display: block;

    width: 72%;
    height: 100%;

    background: var(--green);
}

.zhi-career-grid {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;

    gap: 10px;
}

.zhi-career-grid > div {
    min-height: 100px;

    padding: 16px;

    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;

    border: 1px solid #18372b;
    border-radius: 9px;

    background: #08130f;
}

.zhi-career-grid i {
    margin-bottom: 10px;

    color: var(--green);

    font-style: normal;
}

.zhi-career-grid strong {
    font-size: 9px;
}

.zhi-career-grid span {
    margin-top: 4px;

    color: #61766d;

    font-size: 7px;
}

.zhi-profile-footer {
    margin-top: 17px;

    color: #73877f;

    font-size: 8px;
    text-align: center;
}


/* =========================================================
   RESUME + PORTFOLIO
   ========================================================= */

.zhi-showcase {
    min-height: 510px;

    border-radius: 17px;
}

.zhi-resume-paper {
    position: absolute;

    width: 250px;
    height: 350px;

    left: 55px;
    top: 65px;

    z-index: 3;

    padding: 26px;

    border-radius: 4px;

    background: #f1f4f0;
    color: #0c1511;

    transform: rotate(-5deg);

    box-shadow:
        0 25px 50px rgba(0, 0, 0, .35);
}

.zhi-resume-name {
    font-size: 17px;
    font-weight: 900;
}

.zhi-resume-name span {
    display: block;

    margin-top: 4px;

    color: #397556;

    font-size: 7px;
}

.zhi-paper-line {
    width: 70%;
    height: 5px;

    margin-top: 8px;

    border-radius: 10px;

    background: #c9d0cc;
}

.zhi-paper-line.zhi-long {
    width: 100%;
    margin-top: 20px;
}

.zhi-resume-paper h5 {
    margin: 24px 0 10px;

    color: #237f4d;

    font-size: 7px;
}

.zhi-paper-block {
    height: 7px;

    margin-top: 6px;

    border-radius: 10px;

    background: #c8d0cc;
}

.zhi-paper-block.zhi-short {
    width: 70%;
}

.zhi-resume-tags {
    display: flex;
    flex-wrap: wrap;

    gap: 4px;
}

.zhi-resume-tags span {
    padding: 4px 6px;

    border-radius: 4px;

    background: #d8e8df;

    color: #27784d;

    font-size: 5px;
}

.zhi-pdf-badge {
    position: absolute;

    right: 17px;
    bottom: 17px;

    padding: 6px;

    border-radius: 4px;

    background: #dce5e0;

    font-size: 6px;
    font-weight: 900;
}

.zhi-portfolio-screen {
    position: absolute;

    width: 330px;
    height: 280px;

    right: 40px;
    bottom: 40px;

    z-index: 2;

    padding: 42px 25px 25px;

    border: 1px solid #25483a;
    border-radius: 11px;

    background:
        radial-gradient(
            circle at 80% 20%,
            rgba(53, 220, 120, .1),
            transparent 35%
        ),
        #050b09;

    transform: rotate(4deg);
}

.zhi-browser-bar {
    position: absolute;

    left: 0;
    right: 0;
    top: 0;

    height: 30px;

    padding: 0 10px;

    display: flex;
    align-items: center;

    gap: 5px;

    border-bottom: 1px solid #183128;
}

.zhi-browser-bar span {
    width: 5px;
    height: 5px;

    border-radius: 50%;

    background: #375047;
}

.zhi-portfolio-screen > small {
    color: var(--green);

    font-size: 6px;
}

.zhi-portfolio-screen h3 {
    margin: 10px 0;

    font-size: 24px;
    line-height: 1;
}

.zhi-portfolio-screen p {
    color: #72877e;

    font-size: 8px;
}

.zhi-portfolio-project {
    position: absolute;

    left: 25px;
    right: 25px;
    bottom: 25px;

    padding: 13px;

    display: flex;
    justify-content: space-between;

    border: 1px solid #19392c;
    border-radius: 7px;

    font-size: 7px;
}

.zhi-portfolio-project span {
    color: var(--green);
}


/* =========================================================
   CAREER AI
   ========================================================= */

.zhi-copilot {
    min-height: 470px;

    padding: 27px;

    border-radius: 17px;

    background:
        linear-gradient(
            #07100d,
            #07100d
        ) padding-box,

        conic-gradient(
            from var(--zhi-angle),
            transparent 0deg,
            transparent 302deg,
            rgba(81, 64, 255, .15) 320deg,
            var(--green) 345deg,
            #9effbd 353deg,
            transparent 360deg
        ) border-box;
}

.zhi-copilot-head {
    padding-bottom: 17px;

    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: space-between;

    border-bottom: 1px solid #173027;
}

.zhi-copilot-head div {
    display: flex;
    gap: 8px;
}

.zhi-copilot-head div span {
    color: var(--green);
}

.zhi-copilot-head strong {
    font-size: 11px;
}

.zhi-copilot-head small {
    color: #5e746b;

    font-size: 7px;
}

.zhi-copilot-question {
    max-width: 65%;

    margin: 30px 0 22px auto;
    padding: 13px 15px;

    border-radius: 11px 11px 3px 11px;

    background: #112019;
    color: #c6d4ce;

    font-size: 9px;
}

.zhi-copilot-answer {
    display: flex;

    gap: 12px;
}

.zhi-copilot-answer p {
    margin: 0;

    color: #879990;

    font-size: 9px;
    line-height: 1.7;
}

.zhi-next-actions {
    margin-top: 12px;

    display: flex;
    gap: 5px;
}

.zhi-next-actions span {
    padding: 6px 8px;

    border-radius: 5px;

    background: rgba(53, 220, 120, .07);
    color: var(--green);

    font-size: 6px;
}

.zhi-tool-pills {
    position: absolute;

    left: 27px;
    right: 27px;
    bottom: 27px;

    display: flex;
    flex-wrap: wrap;

    gap: 7px;
}

.zhi-tool-pills span {
    padding: 8px 10px;

    border: 1px solid #18372b;
    border-radius: 6px;

    color: #81958d;

    font-size: 7px;
}


/* =========================================================
   LOOP
   ========================================================= */

.zhi-loop-section {
    padding: 120px 0;

    border-top:
        1px solid rgba(65, 111, 91, .12);

    background:
        radial-gradient(
            circle at 50% 65%,
            rgba(53, 220, 120, .08),
            transparent 30%
        );
}

.zhi-loop {
    max-width: 920px;

    margin: 70px auto 0;

    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;

    gap: 18px;
}

.zhi-loop-item {
    width: 125px;
    height: 125px;

    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;

    border: 1px solid #1d3c30;
    border-radius: 50%;

    background: #07100d;
}

.zhi-loop-item b {
    color: #537067;

    font-size: 8px;
}

.zhi-loop-item span {
    margin-top: 7px;

    font-size: 11px;
    font-weight: 800;
}

.zhi-loop-green {
    border-color: var(--green);

    box-shadow:
        0 0 40px rgba(53, 220, 120, .1);
}

.zhi-loop-green b,
.zhi-loop-green span {
    color: var(--green);
}

.zhi-loop-arrow {
    color: var(--green);

    font-size: 20px;
}

.zhi-loop-note {
    margin-top: 40px;

    color: #9cb0a7;

    font-size: 13px;
    font-style: italic;

    text-align: center;

    transform: rotate(-1deg);
}


/* =========================================================
   FINAL CTA
   ========================================================= */

.zhi-final {
    padding: 25px 0 120px;
}

.zhi-final-card {
    min-height: 420px;

    padding: 65px;

    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;

    border-radius: 19px;

    text-align: center;

    background:
        linear-gradient(
            rgba(6, 16, 12, .94),
            rgba(6, 16, 12, .94)
        ) padding-box,

        conic-gradient(
            from var(--zhi-angle),
            transparent 0deg,
            transparent 302deg,
            rgba(53, 220, 120, .1) 320deg,
            var(--green) 346deg,
            #9effbd 353deg,
            transparent 360deg
        ) border-box;
}

.zhi-final-card > p {
    max-width: 580px;
}

.zhi-final-card .zhi-btn {
    margin-top: 28px;
}

.zhi-final-decoration {
    margin-bottom: 18px;

    color: var(--green);

    font-size: 30px;
}

.zhi-final-note {
    margin-top: 30px;

    color: #9bafa6;

    font-size: 12px;
    font-style: italic;

    transform: rotate(-2deg);
}


/* =========================================================
   REVEAL ANIMATION
   ========================================================= */

.zhi-reveal {
    opacity: 0;

    transform: translateY(20px);

    transition:
        opacity .6s ease,
        transform .6s ease;
}

.zhi-reveal.zhi-visible {
    opacity: 1;

    transform: translateY(0);
}


/* =========================================================
   KEYFRAMES
   ========================================================= */

@keyframes zhiOrbitSpin {
    from {
        transform:
            translate(-50%, -50%)
            rotate(0deg);
    }

    to {
        transform:
            translate(-50%, -50%)
            rotate(360deg);
    }
}


/* =========================================================
   TABLET
   ========================================================= */

@media (max-width: 950px) {

    .zhi-hero > .zhi-container,
    .zhi-step-grid,
    .zhi-reverse {
        grid-template-columns: 1fr;
    }

    .zhi-hero-content {
        text-align: center;
    }

    .zhi-hero-content > p {
        margin-left: auto;
        margin-right: auto;
    }

    .zhi-hero-actions {
        justify-content: center;
    }

    .zhi-hero-map {
        max-width: 650px;

        margin: 30px auto 0;
    }

    .zhi-step-grid {
        gap: 55px;
    }

    .zhi-reverse .zhi-visual {
        order: 2;
    }

    .zhi-reverse .zhi-step-copy {
        order: 1;
    }

    .zhi-flow-strip {
        flex-wrap: wrap;
    }

    .zhi-flow-arrow {
        display: none;
    }

    .zhi-loop {
        flex-wrap: wrap;
    }

    .zhi-loop-arrow {
        display: none;
    }
}


/* =========================================================
   MOBILE
   ========================================================= */

@media (max-width: 650px) {

    .zhi-container {
        width: calc(100% - 28px);
    }

    .zhi-hero {
        min-height: auto;

        padding: 75px 0;
    }

    .zhi-hero-content h1 {
        font-size: 48px;
    }

    .zhi-hero-map {
        height: 430px;

        transform: scale(.9);
    }

    .zhi-orbit {
        width: 275px;
        height: 275px;
    }

    .zhi-core {
        width: 145px;
        height: 145px;
    }

    .zhi-node {
        min-width: 90px;

        padding: 10px;
    }

    .zhi-section,
    .zhi-step-section {
        padding: 75px 0;
    }

    .zhi-flow-strip {
        display: grid;
        grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
    }

    .zhi-flow-item {
        width: 100%;
    }

    .zhi-ai-tools {
        grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
    }

    .zhi-project-visual {
        padding: 25px;
    }

    .zhi-project-bottom {
        left: 25px;
        right: 25px;
    }

    .zhi-career-grid {
        grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
    }

    .zhi-showcase {
        min-height: 500px;
    }

    .zhi-resume-paper {
        width: 205px;
        height: 315px;

        left: 20px;
        top: 60px;
    }

    .zhi-portfolio-screen {
        width: 250px;
        height: 240px;

        right: 15px;
        bottom: 30px;
    }

    .zhi-loop-item {
        width: 100px;
        height: 100px;
    }

    .zhi-final-card {
        min-height: 390px;

        padding: 35px 22px;
    }
}


/* =========================================================
   REDUCED MOTION
   ========================================================= */

@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {

    .zhi-visual,
    .zhi-showcase,
    .zhi-final-card,
    .zhi-orbit {
        animation: none;
    }

    .zhi-reveal {
        opacity: 1;
        transform: none;
    }
}
</style>

<script data-wp-block-html="js">
function zevHowInitialize() {

    var smoothLinks =
        document.querySelectorAll(
            '#zev-how-page a[href^="#"]'
        );

    smoothLinks.forEach(
        function (link) {

            link.addEventListener(
                "click",
                function (event) {

                    var targetId =
                        link.getAttribute("href");

                    var target =
                        document.querySelector(targetId);

                    if (!target) {
                        return;
                    }

                    event.preventDefault();

                    target.scrollIntoView({
                        behavior: "smooth",
                        block: "start"
                    });
                }
            );
        }
    );


    var revealItems =
        document.querySelectorAll(
            "#zev-how-page .zhi-step-copy, " +
            "#zev-how-page .zhi-visual, " +
            "#zev-how-page .zhi-showcase, " +
            "#zev-how-page .zhi-flow-item, " +
            "#zev-how-page .zhi-loop-item"
        );


    revealItems.forEach(
        function (item) {
            item.classList.add("zhi-reveal");
        }
    );


    if ("IntersectionObserver" in window) {

        var observer =
            new IntersectionObserver(
                function (entries) {

                    entries.forEach(
                        function (entry) {

                            if (entry.isIntersecting) {

                                entry.target.classList.add(
                                    "zhi-visible"
                                );

                                observer.unobserve(
                                    entry.target
                                );
                            }
                        }
                    );
                },
                {
                    threshold: 0.08
                }
            );


        revealItems.forEach(
            function (item) {
                observer.observe(item);
            }
        );

    } else {

        revealItems.forEach(
            function (item) {
                item.classList.add("zhi-visible");
            }
        );
    }
}


if (document.readyState === "loading") {

    document.addEventListener(
        "DOMContentLoaded",
        function () {
            zevHowInitialize();
        }
    );

} else {

    zevHowInitialize();
}
</script>

    <!-- HERO -->

                </div>

                </div>

                </div>

                <div class="zhi-node zhi-node-2">

                </div>

                    <strong>Projects</strong>
                </div>

                <div class="zhi-node zhi-node-4">
                    <i>04</i>
                    <strong>Career</strong>
                </div>

                <div class="zhi-node zhi-node-5">

                    <strong>Resume</strong>
                </div>

                <div class="zhi-node zhi-node-6">
                    <i>06</i>
                    <strong>Portfolio</strong>
                </div>

                <div class="zhi-floating-note">
                    learn → build → show → grow
                </div>

            </div>

        </div>
    </section>


    <!-- JOURNEY INTRO -->
    <section id="zev-journey" class="zhi-section">
        <div class="zhi-container">

            <div class="zhi-section-heading zhi-center">
                <div class="zhi-kicker">THE ZEVQYN FLOW</div>

                <h2>
                    Your work shouldn't live in
                    <span>separate worlds.</span>
                </h2>

                <p>
                    Every step builds on the one before it. What you research
                    can become what you build — and what you build can become
                    what you show the world.
                </p>
            </div>


            <div class="zhi-flow-strip">

        </div>
    </section>


    <!-- STEP 01 -->
    <section class="zhi-step-section">
        <div class="zhi-container zhi-step-grid">

            <div class="zhi-step-copy">

                <div class="zhi-step-number">01</div>

    <!-- STEP 02 -->

            </div>

        </div>
    </section>


    <!-- STEP 03 -->
    <section class="zhi-step-section">
        <div class="zhi-container zhi-step-grid">

            <div class="zhi-step-copy">

                <div class="zhi-step-number">03</div>

                <div class="zhi-kicker">KNOWLEDGE → SOMETHING REAL</div>

                <h2>
                    Turn research into
                    <span>a project.</span>
                </h2>

                <p>
                    This is where ZEVQYN stops being just a study tool.

                <div class="zhi-loop-item">
                    <b>04</b>
                    <span>Show</span>
                </div>

                <div class="zhi-loop-arrow">↘</div>

                <div class="zhi-loop-item zhi-loop-green">
                    <b>∞</b>
                    <span>Grow</span>
                </div>

            </div>


            <div class="zhi-loop-note">
                repeat until the dream isn't a dream anymore ✦
            </div>

        </div>
    </section>


    <!-- FINAL CTA -->
    <section class="zhi-final">
        <div class="zhi-container">

            <div class="zhi-final-card">

                <div class="zhi-final-decoration">
                    ✦

                    READY WHEN YOU ARE
                </div>

                <h2>
                    Stop collecting potential.<br>
                    <span>Start building with it.</span>

                <p>

                <a href="/register/" class="zhi-btn zhi-btn-primary">

                </a>

<!-- wp:html -->
<style data-wp-block-html="css">
/* =========================================
   ZEVQYN RESEARCH PAGE
========================================= */

.zev-research-page,
.zev-research-page * {
    box-sizing: border-box;
}

.zev-research-page {
    --bg: #030504;
    --panel: #090e12;
    --panel2: #0d1318;
    --border: #1c2935;
    --text: #f5f7fa;
    --muted: #8f9aa7;
    --green: #35b85b;
    --green2: #269747;

    width: 100%;
    min-height: 100vh;
    display: flex;
    background: #030504;
    color: var(--text);
    font-family: Inter, Arial, sans-serif;
}


/* =========================================
   SIDEBAR
========================================= */

.zev-research-sidebar {
    width: 245px;
    min-width: 245px;
    min-height: 100vh;
    padding: 28px 18px;

    background:
        radial-gradient(
            circle at 20% 20%,
            rgba(53,184,91,.08),
            transparent 30%
        ),
        #050807;

    border-right: 1px solid #172019;

    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
}

.zev-nav-title {
    color: #65706d;
    font-size: 11px;
    font-weight: 700;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    letter-spacing: 1.3px;
    padding: 0 12px;
    margin-bottom: 10px;
}

.zev-nav {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    gap: 6px;
}

.zev-nav a {
    color: #aeb7bf !important;
    text-decoration: none !important;

    padding: 12px 14px;
    border-radius: 9px;

    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 12px;

    font-size: 14px;
    font-weight: 500;

    transition: .2s ease;
}

.zev-nav a:hover {
    color: #ffffff !important;
    background: #0c1510;
}

.zev-nav a.active {

<script data-wp-block-html="js">
(function () {

    /* =========================================
       ZEVQYN RESEARCH
    ========================================= */

    const SUPABASE_URL =
        "https://phjizxajnigiiawitkyx.supabase.co";

    const SUPABASE_KEY =
        "sb_publishable_oYTMqlTbVsNqToWxvq6I9w_pQ9NFZWk";

    const API_BASE =
        "https://zevqyn-backend.onrender.com";

    let supabaseClient = null;
    let currentSession = null;
    let workspaces = [];
    let documentCounts = {};

    /* =========================================
       LOAD SUPABASE
    ========================================= */

    function loadSupabase() {

        return new Promise(function (resolve, reject) {

            if (window.supabase) {
                resolve();
                return;
            }

            const script = document.createElement("script");

            script.src =
                "https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@supabase/supabase-js@2/dist/umd/supabase.js";

            script.onload = function () {
                resolve();
            };

            script.onerror = function () {
                reject(new Error("Could not load Supabase."));
            };

            document.head.appendChild(script);

        });

    }


    /* =========================================
       HELPER
    ========================================= */

    function getElement(id) {
        return document.getElementById(id);
    }


    function escapeHTML(value) {

        const div = document.createElement("div");

        div.textContent = value || "";

        return div.innerHTML;

    }


    function showCreateMessage(message, success) {

        const element = getElement("zevqyn-create-message");

        if (!element) {
            return;
        }

        element.textContent = message || "";

        if (success) {
            element.style.color = "#4ed36f";
        } else {
            element.style.color = "#e16b6b";
        }

    }


    /* =========================================
       AUTHENTICATED BACKEND REQUEST
    ========================================= */

    async function apiRequest(path, options) {

        if (!currentSession) {
            throw new Error("Your session has expired.");
        }

        const requestOptions = options || {};

        if (!requestOptions.headers) {
            requestOptions.headers = {};
        }

        requestOptions.headers["Authorization"] =
            "Bearer " + currentSession.access_token;

        const response = await fetch(
            API_BASE + path,
            requestOptions
        );

        if (response.status === 401) {

            await supabaseClient.auth.signOut();

            window.location.href =
                "https://zevqyn.free.je/login/";

            throw new Error("Session expired.");

        }

        if (!response.ok) {

            let message =
                "Backend request failed (" +
                response.status +
                ").";

            try {

                const errorData = await response.json();

                if (errorData.detail) {

                    if (typeof errorData.detail === "string") {
                        message = errorData.detail;
                    }

                }

            } catch (error) {
                /* Keep default message */
            }

            throw new Error(message);

        }

        if (response.status === 204) {
            return null;
        }

        return await response.json();

    }


    /* =========================================
       USER INFORMATION
    ========================================= */

    function displayUser(user) {

        const metadata = user.user_metadata || {};

        let fullName =
            metadata.full_name ||
            metadata.name ||
            "ZEVQYN User";

        const email =
            user.email || "";

        let firstLetter = "Z";

        if (fullName) {
            firstLetter =
                fullName.charAt(0).toUpperCase();
        }

        const nameElement =
            getElement("zevqyn-user-name");

        const emailElement =
            getElement("zevqyn-user-email");

        const avatarElement =
            getElement("zevqyn-user-avatar");


        if (nameElement) {
            nameElement.textContent = fullName;
        }

        if (emailElement) {
            emailElement.textContent = email;
        }

        if (avatarElement) {
            avatarElement.textContent = firstLetter;
        }

    }


    /* =========================================
       LOADING / EMPTY STATE
    ========================================= */

    function showLoading() {

        const loading =
            getElement("zevqyn-research-loading");

        const grid =
            getElement("zevqyn-workspace-grid");

        const empty =
            getElement("zevqyn-empty-state");

        if (loading) {
            loading.style.display = "flex";
        }

        if (grid) {
            grid.style.display = "none";
        }

        if (empty) {
            empty.style.display = "none";
        }

    }


    function hideLoading() {

        const loading =
            getElement("zevqyn-research-loading");

        if (loading) {
            loading.style.display = "none";
        }

    }


    /* =========================================
       LOAD WORKSPACES
    ========================================= */

    async function loadWorkspaces() {

        showLoading();

        try {

            const result =
                await apiRequest(
                    "/api/v1/workspaces",
                    {
                        method: "GET"
                    }
                );

            if (Array.isArray(result)) {
                workspaces = result;
            } else {
                workspaces = [];
            }

            await loadDocumentCounts();

            updateStatistics();

            renderWorkspaces();

        } catch (error) {

            hideLoading();

            console.error(
                "Workspace loading error:",
                error
            );

            const empty =
                getElement("zevqyn-empty-state");

            if (empty) {
                empty.style.display = "flex";
            }

        }

    }


    /* =========================================
       DOCUMENT COUNTS
    ========================================= */

    async function loadDocumentCounts() {

        documentCounts = {};

        const requests =
            workspaces.map(async function (workspace) {

                try {

                    const documents =
                        await apiRequest(
                            "/api/v1/workspaces/" +
                            workspace.id +
                            "/documents",
                            {
                                method: "GET"
                            }
                        );

                    if (Array.isArray(documents)) {

                        documentCounts[workspace.id] =
                            documents.length;

                    } else {

                        documentCounts[workspace.id] = 0;

                    }

                } catch (error) {

                    documentCounts[workspace.id] = 0;

                }

            });

        await Promise.all(requests);

    }


    /* =========================================
       STATISTICS
    ========================================= */

    function updateStatistics() {

        const workspaceCount =
            getElement("zevqyn-workspace-count");

        const documentCount =
            getElement("zevqyn-document-count");

        const chatCount =
            getElement("zevqyn-chat-count");


        if (workspaceCount) {

            workspaceCount.textContent =
                workspaces.length;

        }


        let totalDocuments = 0;

        Object.keys(documentCounts).forEach(
            function (key) {

                totalDocuments +=
                    Number(documentCounts[key] || 0);

            }
        );


        if (documentCount) {

            documentCount.textContent =
                totalDocuments;

        }


        /*
           Chat counting will be connected when
           we build the individual workspace/chat UI.
        */

        if (chatCount) {
            chatCount.textContent = "0";
        }

    }


    /* =========================================
       DATE
    ========================================= */

    function formatDate(value) {

        if (!value) {
            return "Recently created";
        }

        const date = new Date(value);

        if (isNaN(date.getTime())) {
            return "Recently created";
        }

        return date.toLocaleDateString(
            undefined,
            {
                year: "numeric",
                month: "short",
                day: "numeric"
            }
        );

    }


    /* =========================================
       FILTER + SORT
    ========================================= */

    function getVisibleWorkspaces() {

        let result =
            workspaces.slice();

        const searchInput =
            getElement("zevqyn-research-search");

        const sortInput =
            getElement("zevqyn-research-sort");


        let query = "";

        if (searchInput) {

            query =
                searchInput.value
                    .trim()
                    .toLowerCase();

        }


        if (query) {

            result = result.filter(
                function (workspace) {

                    const name =
                        String(
                            workspace.name || ""
                        ).toLowerCase();

                    const description =
                        String(
                            workspace.description || ""
                        ).toLowerCase();


                    if (name.indexOf(query) !== -1) {
                        return true;
                    }

                    if (
                        description.indexOf(query) !== -1
                    ) {
                        return true;
                    }

                    return false;

                }
            );

        }


        let sortValue = "recent";

        if (sortInput) {
            sortValue = sortInput.value;
        }


        result.sort(
            function (a, b) {

                if (sortValue === "name") {

                    return String(a.name || "")
                        .localeCompare(
                            String(b.name || "")
                        );

                }


                const aDate =
                    new Date(
                        a.updated_at ||
                        a.created_at ||
                        0
                    ).getTime();

                const bDate =
                    new Date(
                        b.updated_at ||
                        b.created_at ||
                        0
                    ).getTime();


                if (sortValue === "oldest") {
                    return aDate - bDate;
                }

                return bDate - aDate;

            }
        );


        return result;

    }


    /* =========================================
       RENDER WORKSPACES
    ========================================= */

    function renderWorkspaces() {

        hideLoading();

        const grid =
            getElement("zevqyn-workspace-grid");

        const empty =
            getElement("zevqyn-empty-state");


        if (!grid) {
            return;
        }


        if (workspaces.length === 0) {

            grid.innerHTML = "";
            grid.style.display = "none";

            if (empty) {
                empty.style.display = "flex";
            }

            return;

        }


        if (empty) {
            empty.style.display = "none";
        }


        const visible =
            getVisibleWorkspaces();


        grid.style.display = "grid";
        grid.innerHTML = "";


        if (visible.length === 0) {

            grid.innerHTML =
                '<div style="' +
                'grid-column:1/-1;' +
                'padding:45px 20px;' +
                'text-align:center;' +
                'color:#7f8b93;' +
                'font-size:13px;' +
                '">' +
                'No research workspaces match your search.' +
                '</div>';

            return;

        }


        visible.forEach(
            function (workspace) {

                const card =
                    document.createElement("div");

                card.className =
                    "zev-workspace-card";


                const description =
                    workspace.description ||
                    "No description added yet.";


                const documents =
                    documentCounts[
                        workspace.id
                    ] || 0;


                card.innerHTML =
                    '<div style="' +
                    'display:flex;' +
                    'justify-content:space-between;' +
                    'gap:12px;' +
                    'margin-bottom:16px;' +
                    '">' +

                        '<div style="' +
                        'width:38px;' +
                        'height:38px;' +
                        'border-radius:9px;' +
                        'background:rgba(53,184,91,.1);' +
                        'color:#4ed36f;' +
                        'display:flex;' +
                        'align-items:center;' +
                        'justify-content:center;' +
                        'font-size:17px;' +
                        '">' +
                        '▣' +
                        '</div>' +

                        '<span style="' +
                        'color:#647078;' +
                        'font-size:10px;' +
                        '">' +
                        documents +
                        ' document' +
                        (documents === 1 ? "" : "s") +
                        '</span>' +

                    '</div>' +

                    '<h3 style="' +
                    'margin:0 0 8px;' +
                    'color:#fff;' +
                    'font-size:15px;' +
                    'font-weight:800;' +
                    '">' +
                    escapeHTML(workspace.name) +
                    '</h3>' +

                    '<p style="' +
                    'margin:0 0 18px;' +
                    'color:#78858d;' +
                    'font-size:11px;' +
                    'line-height:1.6;' +
                    '">' +
                    escapeHTML(description) +
                    '</p>' +

                    '<div style="' +
                    'color:#59666d;' +
                    'font-size:9px;' +
                    '">' +
                    'Updated ' +
                    escapeHTML(
                        formatDate(
                            workspace.updated_at ||
                            workspace.created_at
                        )
                    ) +
                    '</div>';


                card.addEventListener(
                    "click",
                    function () {

                        /*
                           Next step:
                           open individual Research Workspace.
                        */

                      card.addEventListener(
    "click",
    function () {

        window.location.assign(
            "/research-workspace/?id=" +
            encodeURIComponent(workspace.id)
        );

    }
);

                    }
                );


                grid.appendChild(card);

            }
        );

    }


    /* =========================================
       MODAL
    ========================================= */

    function openModal() {

        const modal =
            getElement("zevqyn-create-modal");

        const title =
            getElement("zevqyn-research-title");

        if (!modal) {
            return;
        }

        modal.hidden = false;

        showCreateMessage("", false);

        setTimeout(
            function () {

                if (title) {
                    title.focus();
                }

            },
            100
        );

    }


    function closeModal() {

        const modal =
            getElement("zevqyn-create-modal");

        const form =
            getElement(
                "zevqyn-create-research-form"
            );

        if (modal) {
            modal.hidden = true;
        }

        if (form) {
            form.reset();
        }

        showCreateMessage("", false);

    }


    /* =========================================
       CREATE WORKSPACE
    ========================================= */

    async function createWorkspace(event) {

        event.preventDefault();


        const titleInput =
            getElement("zevqyn-research-title");

        const descriptionInput =
            getElement(
                "zevqyn-research-description"
            );

        const button =
            getElement("zevqyn-create-btn");


        if (!titleInput) {
            return;
        }


        const name =
            titleInput.value.trim();

        let description = "";

        if (descriptionInput) {
            description =
                descriptionInput.value.trim();
        }


        if (!name) {

            showCreateMessage(
                "Please enter a workspace title.",
                false
            );

            return;

        }


        if (button) {

            button.disabled = true;
            button.textContent = "Creating...";

        }


        showCreateMessage(
            "Creating your workspace...",
            true
        );


        try {

            const created =
                await apiRequest(
                    "/api/v1/workspaces",
                    {
                        method: "POST",

                        headers: {
                            "Content-Type":
                                "application/json"
                        },

                        body: JSON.stringify({
                            name: name,
                            description: description
                        })
                    }
                );


            if (created) {

                showCreateMessage(
                    "Workspace created successfully.",
                    true
                );


                await loadWorkspaces();


                setTimeout(
                    function () {
                        closeModal();
                    },
                    500
                );

            }


        } catch (error) {

            console.error(
                "Create workspace error:",
                error
            );

            showCreateMessage(
                error.message ||
                "Could not create workspace.",
                false
            );

        } finally {

            if (button) {

                button.disabled = false;
                button.textContent =
                    "Create Workspace";

            }

        }

    }


    /* =========================================
       EVENTS
    ========================================= */

    function setupEvents() {

        const newButton =
            getElement("zevqyn-new-research");

        const emptyButton =
            getElement("zevqyn-empty-create");

        const closeButton =
            getElement("zevqyn-modal-close");

        const cancelButton =
            getElement("zevqyn-modal-cancel");

        const modal =
            getElement("zevqyn-create-modal");

        const form =
            getElement(
                "zevqyn-create-research-form"
            );

        const search =
            getElement("zevqyn-research-search");

        const sort =
            getElement("zevqyn-research-sort");

        const signOut =
            getElement("zevqyn-signout");


        if (newButton) {

            newButton.addEventListener(
                "click",
                openModal
            );

        }


        if (emptyButton) {

            emptyButton.addEventListener(
                "click",
                openModal
            );

        }


        if (closeButton) {

            closeButton.addEventListener(
                "click",
                closeModal
            );

        }


        if (cancelButton) {

            cancelButton.addEventListener(
                "click",
                closeModal
            );

        }


        if (modal) {

            modal.addEventListener(
                "click",
                function (event) {

                    if (event.target === modal) {
                        closeModal();
                    }

                }
            );

        }


        document.addEventListener(
            "keydown",
            function (event) {

                if (event.key === "Escape") {
                    closeModal();
                }

            }
        );


        if (form) {

            form.addEventListener(
                "submit",
                createWorkspace
            );

        }


        if (search) {

            search.addEventListener(
                "input",
                renderWorkspaces
            );

        }


        if (sort) {

            sort.addEventListener(
                "change",
                renderWorkspaces
            );

        }


        if (signOut) {

            signOut.addEventListener(
                "click",
                async function (event) {

                    event.preventDefault();

                    await supabaseClient
                        .auth
                        .signOut();

                    window.location.href =
                        "https://zevqyn.free.je/login/";

                }
            );

        }

    }


    /* =========================================
       START APP
    ========================================= */

    async function startResearchPage() {

        try {

            await loadSupabase();


            supabaseClient =
                window.supabase.createClient(
                    SUPABASE_URL,
                    SUPABASE_KEY
                );


            const sessionResult =
                await supabaseClient
                    .auth
                    .getSession();


            currentSession =
                sessionResult.data.session;


            if (!currentSession) {

                window.location.href =
                    "https://zevqyn.free.je/login/";

                return;

            }


            displayUser(
                currentSession.user
            );


            setupEvents();


            await loadWorkspaces();


        } catch (error) {

            console.error(
                "ZEVQYN Research initialization error:",
                error
            );


            const loading =
                getElement(
                    "zevqyn-research-loading"
                );

            if (loading) {

                loading.innerHTML =
                    '<div style="' +
                    'color:#e16b6b;' +
                    'text-align:center;' +
                    'line-height:1.7;' +
                    '">' +
                    'Could not load your research workspace.' +
                    '<br>' +
                    '<span style="' +
                    'color:#77838b;' +
                    'font-size:10px;' +
                    '">' +
                    escapeHTML(error.message) +
                    '</span>' +
                    '</div>';

            }

        }

    }


  if (document.readyState === "loading") {

    document.addEventListener(
        "DOMContentLoaded",
        function () {
            startResearchPage();
        }
    );

} else {

    startResearchPage();

}

})();
</script>

<div class="zev-research-page">

    <!-- =========================

            <div class="zev-research-heading">

                </div>

                <h1>

                </h1>

                <p>
                    Upload your sources, explore ideas and turn
                    research into career-ready work.
                </p>

            </div>


            <div class="zev-user">

                <div class="zev-avatar" id="zevqyn-user-avatar">

                </div>

                <div>

                    <div class="zev-user-name" id="zevqyn-user-name">

                    </div>

                    <div class="zev-user-email" id="zevqyn-user-email">

                    </div>

                </div>

            </div>

        </div>


        <!-- =========================
             ACTION BAR
        ========================== -->
        <div class="zev-research-actions">

            <div class="zev-search-box">

                <span class="zev-search-icon">
                    ⌕
                </span>

                <input type="text" id="zevqyn-research-search" placeholder="Search research workspaces..." autocomplete="off">

            </div>


            <button type="button" class="zev-new-research-btn" id="zevqyn-new-research">
                <span>＋</span>
                New Research
            </button>

        </div>


        <!-- =========================
             STATS
        ========================== -->
        <section class="zev-research-stats">

            <div class="zev-mini-stat">

                <div class="zev-mini-stat-icon">
                    ▣
                </div>

                <div>

                    <div class="zev-mini-stat-number" id="zevqyn-workspace-count">
                        0
                    </div>

                    <div class="zev-mini-stat-label">
                        Workspaces
                    </div>

                </div>

            </div>


            <div class="zev-mini-stat">

                <div class="zev-mini-stat-icon">
                    ▤
                </div>

                <div>

                    <div class="zev-mini-stat-number" id="zevqyn-document-count">
                        0
                    </div>

                    <div class="zev-mini-stat-label">
                        Documents
                    </div>

                </div>

            </div>


            <div class="zev-mini-stat">

                <div class="zev-mini-stat-icon">
                    ✦
                </div>

                <div>

                    <div class="zev-mini-stat-number" id="zevqyn-chat-count">
                        0
                    </div>

                    <div class="zev-mini-stat-label">
                        AI Conversations
                    </div>

                </div>

            </div>

        </section>


        <!-- =========================
             WORKSPACES
        ========================== -->
        <section class="zev-workspaces-section">

            <div class="zev-section-header">

                <div>

                    <h2>
                        Your Research
                    </h2>

                    <p>
                        Your research workspaces will appear here.
                    </p>

                </div>


                <select id="zevqyn-research-sort">

                    <option value="recent">
                        Recently updated
                    </option>

                    <option value="newest">
                        Newest
                    </option>

                    <option value="oldest">
                        Oldest
                    </option>

                    <option value="name">
                        Name
                    </option>

                </select>

            </div>


            <!-- LOADING -->
            <div class="zev-research-loading" id="zevqyn-research-loading">

                <div class="zev-loader"></div>

                <p>
                    Loading your research...
                </p>

            </div>


            <!-- WORKSPACE GRID -->
            <div class="zev-workspace-grid" id="zevqyn-workspace-grid">
            </div>


            <!-- =========================
                 EMPTY STATE
            ========================== -->
            <div class="zev-empty-state" id="zevqyn-empty-state">

                <div class="zev-empty-icon">
                    ✦
                </div>

                <div class="zev-empty-badge">
                    YOUR FIRST WORKSPACE
                </div>

                <h2>
                    Start your first research workspace
                </h2>

                <p>
                    Create a workspace and bring your research
                    materials together. Upload PDFs, DOCX, TXT or
                    Markdown files and use AI to understand your
                    sources.
                </p>


                <button type="button" class="zev-empty-create-btn" id="zevqyn-empty-create">
                    ＋ Create Research
                </button>


                <div class="zev-supported-files">

                    <span>PDF</span>
                    <span>DOCX</span>
                    <span>TXT</span>
                    <span>MD</span>

                </div>

            </div>

        </section>


        <!-- =========================
             RESEARCH FLOW
        ========================== -->
        <section class="zev-research-flow">

            <div class="zev-flow-header">

                <span>
                    HOW ZEVQYN RESEARCH WORKS
                </span>

                <h2>
                    From sources to something useful.
                </h2>

            </div>


            <div class="zev-flow-grid">


                <!-- STEP 1 -->
                <div class="zev-flow-card">

                    <div class="zev-flow-number">
                        01
                    </div>

                    <div class="zev-flow-icon">
                        ＋
                    </div>

                    <h3>
                        Upload
                    </h3>

                    <p>
                        Add PDFs, documents, notes and other
                        supported research files.
                    </p>

                </div>


                <!-- STEP 2 -->
                <div class="zev-flow-card">

                    <div class="zev-flow-number">
                        02
                    </div>

                    <div class="zev-flow-icon">
                        ✦
                    </div>

                    <h3>
                        Understand
                    </h3>

                    <p>
                        ZEVQYN processes your sources so they
                        can be searched and understood by AI.
                    </p>

                </div>


                <!-- STEP 3 -->
                <div class="zev-flow-card">

                    <div class="zev-flow-number">
                        03
                    </div>

                    <div class="zev-flow-icon">
                        ◇
                    </div>

                    <h3>
                        Ask
                    </h3>

                    <p>
                        Chat with your research and receive
                        source-backed answers with citations.
                    </p>

                </div>


                <!-- STEP 4 -->
                <div class="zev-flow-card">

                    <div class="zev-flow-number">
                        04
                    </div>

                    <div class="zev-flow-icon">
                        ↗
                    </div>

                    <h3>
                        Build
                    </h3>

                    <p>
                        Turn useful research into projects,
                        resume experience and portfolio work.
                    </p>

                </div>

            </div>

        </section>


        <!-- =========================
             CREATE WORKSPACE MODAL
        ========================== -->
        <div class="zev-modal-overlay" id="zevqyn-create-modal" hidden="">

            <div class="zev-modal">

                <button type="button" class="zev-modal-close" id="zevqyn-modal-close">
                    ×
                </button>


                <div class="zev-modal-icon">
                    ▣
                </div>


                <h2>
                    Create Research Workspace
                </h2>

                <p>
                    Give your research a name and optional
                    description. You can upload sources after
                    creating it.
                </p>


                <form id="zevqyn-create-research-form">

                    <div class="zev-field">

                        <label for="zevqyn-research-title">
                            Workspace name
                        </label>

                        <input type="text" id="zevqyn-research-title" placeholder="e.g. Artificial Intelligence Research" maxlength="100" required="">

                    </div>


                    <div class="zev-field">

                        <label for="zevqyn-research-description">
                            Description
                            <span>Optional</span>
                        </label>

                        <textarea id="zevqyn-research-description" placeholder="What are you researching?" maxlength="500" rows="4"></textarea>

                    </div>


                    <div class="zev-form-message" id="zevqyn-create-message">
                    </div>


                    <div class="zev-modal-actions">

                        <button type="button" class="zev-cancel-btn" id="zevqyn-modal-cancel">
                            Cancel
                        </button>

                        <button type="submit" class="zev-create-btn" id="zevqyn-create-btn">
                            Create Workspace
                        </button>

                    </div>

                </form>

            </div>

        </div>


    </main>

</div>
