                </div>

                <div class="zev-career-stat">
                    <span class="zev-career-stat-label">Certificates</span>
                    <strong id="zev-career-certificate-count">0</strong>
                    <small>Achievements</small>
                </div>

            </section>

            <!-- Profile -->
            <section class="zev-career-panel zev-career-profile-panel">

                <div class="zev-career-section-heading">

                    <div>
                        <span class="zev-career-section-kicker">
                            PROFESSIONAL IDENTITY
                        </span>

                        <h2>Career Profile</h2>

                        <p>
                            Your reusable professional information across ZEVQYN.
                        </p>
                    </div>

                    <button type="button" id="zev-career-save-profile" class="zev-career-btn zev-career-btn-primary">
                        Save Profile
                    </button>

                </div>

                <div class="zev-career-profile-layout">

                    <!-- Avatar -->
                    <div class="zev-career-profile-preview">

                        <div class="zev-career-avatar-wrap">

                            <img id="zev-career-avatar" class="zev-career-avatar" alt="Profile">

                            <div id="zev-career-avatar-fallback" class="zev-career-avatar-fallback">
                                Z
                            </div>

                        </div>

                        <strong id="zev-career-preview-name">
                            Your Name
                        </strong>

                        <span id="zev-career-preview-username">
                            @username
                        </span>

                        <p id="zev-career-preview-location">
                            Add your location
                        </p>

                    </div>

                    <!-- Fields -->
                    <div class="zev-career-profile-fields">

                        <div class="zev-career-form-grid">

                            <div class="zev-career-field">
                                <label for="zev-profile-full-name">
                                    Full Name
                                </label>
                                <input id="zev-profile-full-name" type="text" placeholder="Hussnain Ahmad">
                            </div>

                            <div class="zev-career-field">
                                <label for="zev-profile-username">
                                    Username
                                </label>
                                <input id="zev-profile-username" type="text" placeholder="hussnain">
                            </div>

                            <div class="zev-career-field">
                                <label for="zev-profile-location">
                                    Location
                                </label>
                                <input id="zev-profile-location" type="text" placeholder="Islamabad, Pakistan">
                            </div>

                            <div class="zev-career-field">
                                <label for="zev-profile-phone">
                                    Phone
                                </label>
                                <input id="zev-profile-phone" type="text" placeholder="+92...">
                            </div>

                            <div class="zev-career-field zev-career-field-full">
                                <label for="zev-profile-bio">
                                    Professional Bio
                                </label>
                                <textarea id="zev-profile-bio" rows="4" placeholder="Tell people about your professional journey..."></textarea>
                            </div>

                            <div class="zev-career-field zev-career-field-full">
                                <label for="zev-profile-avatar">
                                    Profile Image URL
                                </label>
                                <input id="zev-profile-avatar" type="url" placeholder="https://...">
                            </div>

                            <div class="zev-career-field">
                                <label for="zev-profile-github">
                                    GitHub
                                </label>
                                <input id="zev-profile-github" type="url" placeholder="https://github.com/...">
                            </div>

                            <div class="zev-career-field">
                                <label for="zev-profile-linkedin">
                                    LinkedIn
                                </label>
                                <input id="zev-profile-linkedin" type="url" placeholder="https://linkedin.com/in/...">
                            </div>

                            <div class="zev-career-field zev-career-field-full">
                                <label for="zev-profile-website">
                                    Website
                                </label>
                                <input id="zev-profile-website" type="url" placeholder="https://...">
                            </div>

                        </div>

                    </div>

                </div>

            </section>

            <!-- Career Records -->
            <section class="zev-career-panel">

                <div class="zev-career-section-heading">

                    <div>
                        <span class="zev-career-section-kicker">
                            CAREER LIBRARY
                        </span>

                        <h2>Career Records</h2>

                        <p>
                            Manage the information used by your resumes
                            and portfolios.
                        </p>
                    </div>

                </div>

                <!-- Tabs -->
                <div class="zev-career-tabs">

                    <button type="button" class="zev-career-tab active" data-career-tab="projects">
                        Projects
                    </button>

                    <button type="button" class="zev-career-tab" data-career-tab="skills">
                        Skills
                    </button>

                    <button type="button" class="zev-career-tab" data-career-tab="education">
                        Education
                    </button>

                    <button type="button" class="zev-career-tab" data-career-tab="certificates">
                        Certificates
                    </button>

                </div>

                <!-- PROJECTS -->
                <div id="zev-career-tab-projects" class="zev-career-tab-content active">

                    <div class="zev-career-content-header">
                        <div>
                            <h3>Projects</h3>
                            <p>
                                Projects you can reuse across ZEVQYN.
                            </p>
                        </div>

                        <button type="button" class="zev-career-btn zev-career-btn-primary" data-career-add="project">
                            + Add Project
                        </button>
                    </div>

                    <div id="zev-career-projects" class="zev-career-record-grid"></div>

                </div>

                <!-- SKILLS -->
                <div id="zev-career-tab-skills" class="zev-career-tab-content">

                    <div class="zev-career-content-header">
                        <div>
                            <h3>Skills</h3>
                            <p>
                                Track your professional capabilities.
                            </p>
                        </div>

                        <button type="button" class="zev-career-btn zev-career-btn-primary" data-career-add="skill">
                            + Add Skill
                        </button>
                    </div>

                    <div id="zev-career-skills" class="zev-career-record-grid"></div>

                </div>

                <!-- EDUCATION -->
                <div id="zev-career-tab-education" class="zev-career-tab-content">

                    <div class="zev-career-content-header">
                        <div>
                            <h3>Education</h3>
                            <p>
                                Your academic background.
                            </p>
                        </div>

                        <button type="button" class="zev-career-btn zev-career-btn-primary" data-career-add="education">
                            + Add Education
                        </button>
                    </div>

                    <div id="zev-career-education" class="zev-career-record-grid"></div>

                </div>

                <!-- CERTIFICATES -->
                <div id="zev-career-tab-certificates" class="zev-career-tab-content">

                    <div class="zev-career-content-header">
                        <div>
                            <h3>Certificates</h3>
                            <p>
                                Certifications and professional achievements.
                            </p>
                        </div>

                        <button type="button" class="zev-career-btn zev-career-btn-primary" data-career-add="certificate">
                            + Add Certificate
                        </button>
                    </div>

                    <div id="zev-career-certificates" class="zev-career-record-grid"></div>

                </div>

            </section>

        </main>

    </div>

    <!-- Modal -->
    <div id="zev-career-modal" class="zev-career-modal">

        <div class="zev-career-modal-backdrop" data-career-close-modal=""></div>

        <div class="zev-career-modal-card">

            <div class="zev-career-modal-header">

                <div>
                    <span class="zev-career-section-kicker">
                        CAREER RECORD
                    </span>

                    <h2 id="zev-career-modal-title">
                        Add Record
                    </h2>
                </div>

                <button type="button" id="zev-career-modal-close" class="zev-career-close" aria-label="Close">
                    ×
                </button>

            </div>

            <form id="zev-career-modal-form">

                <div id="zev-career-modal-fields"></div>

                <div class="zev-career-modal-actions">

                    <button type="button" id="zev-career-modal-cancel" class="zev-career-btn zev-career-btn-secondary">
                        Cancel
                    </button>

                    <button type="submit" id="zev-career-modal-save" class="zev-career-btn zev-career-btn-primary">
                        Save
                    </button>

                </div>

            </form>

        </div>

    </div>

</div>
<!-- /wp:html -->

item.title: Career AI
item.dc:creator: hussnain
item.content:encoded:
<!-- wp:html -->
<style data-wp-block-html="css">
/* =========================================================
   ZEVQYN CAREER AI
   ========================================================= */

#zev-career-ai,
#zev-career-ai * {
    box-sizing: border-box;
}

#zev-career-ai {
    --bg: #07090d;
    --panel: #0c1016;
    --panel-2: #10151d;
    --panel-3: #141a23;
    --border: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08);
    --border-hover: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.15);
    --text: #f4f7fb;
    --muted: #8d97a8;
    --muted-2: #697384;
    --green: #79f2a6;
    --green-soft: rgba(121, 242, 166, 0.11);
    --cyan: #6ee7f5;
    --violet: #9d7cff;

    width: 100%;
    min-height: 100vh;
    display: flex;
    background:
        radial-gradient(circle at 76% 5%, rgba(78, 91, 255, 0.09), transparent 28%),
        radial-gradient(circle at 45% 100%, rgba(56, 214, 151, 0.05), transparent 30%),
        var(--bg);
    color: var(--text);
    font-family: Inter, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", sans-serif;
    line-height: 1.5;
}

/* Remove theme spacing around app where possible */
.entry-content:has(#zev-career-ai),
.wp-block-post-content:has(#zev-career-ai) {
    margin: 0 !important;
    padding: 0 !important;
    max-width: none !important;
}

#zev-career-ai button,
#zev-career-ai textarea,
#zev-career-ai input,
#zev-career-ai select {
    font: inherit;
}

#zev-career-ai button {
    color: inherit;
}

/* =========================================================
   SIDEBAR
   ========================================================= */

.zev-cai-sidebar {
    width: 270px;
    min-width: 270px;
    min-height: 100vh;
    position: sticky;
    top: 0;
    align-self: flex-start;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    padding: 26px 18px 20px;
    background: rgba(8, 11, 16, 0.94);
    border-right: 1px solid var(--border);
    backdrop-filter: blur(18px);
    z-index: 10;
}

.zev-cai-brand {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 12px;
    padding: 0 7px;
    margin-bottom: 28px;
}

.zev-cai-brand-icon {
    width: 38px;
    height: 38px;
    border-radius: 11px;
    display: grid;
    place-items: center;
    flex: 0 0 auto;
    font-weight: 800;
    font-size: 16px;
    color: #07100b;
    background: linear-gradient(135deg, #8af5ae, #62dfbd);
    box-shadow: 0 0 28px rgba(121, 242, 166, 0.12);
}

.zev-cai-brand strong,
.zev-cai-brand span {
    display: block;
}

.zev-cai-brand strong {
    font-size: 15px;
    letter-spacing: 0.08em;
}

.zev-cai-brand span {
    margin-top: 1px;
    color: var(--muted);
    font-size: 12px;
}

.zev-cai-new-chat {
    width: 100%;
    min-height: 45px;
    border: 1px solid rgba(121, 242, 166, 0.2);
    border-radius: 11px;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    gap: 8px;
    cursor: pointer;
    background: var(--green-soft);
    color: #a5f7c2 !important;
    font-size: 13px !important;
    font-weight: 650;
    transition: 0.2s ease;
}

.zev-cai-new-chat:hover {
    transform: translateY(-1px);
    background: rgba(121, 242, 166, 0.16);
    border-color: rgba(121, 242, 166, 0.32);
}

.zev-cai-new-chat span {
    font-size: 18px;
    line-height: 1;
}

.zev-cai-sidebar-label {
    margin: 27px 8px 11px;
    color: var(--muted-2);
    font-size: 10px;
    font-weight: 700;
    letter-spacing: 0.13em;
}

.zev-cai-conversations {
    flex: 1;
    overflow-y: auto;
    min-height: 100px;
}

.zev-cai-history-placeholder {
    padding: 15px 10px;
    color: var(--muted-2);
    font-size: 12px;
    line-height: 1.6;
}

.zev-cai-conversations::-webkit-scrollbar,
.zev-cai-chat-messages::-webkit-scrollbar {
    width: 5px;
}

.zev-cai-conversations::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb,
.zev-cai-chat-messages::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb {
    border-radius: 20px;
    background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1);
}

.zev-cai-sidebar-bottom {
    padding-top: 16px;
    border-top: 1px solid var(--border);
}

.zev-cai-back {
    min-height: 42px;
    padding: 0 10px;
    border-radius: 9px;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 9px;
    color: var(--muted) !important;
    text-decoration: none !important;
    font-size: 12px;
    transition: 0.2s ease;
}

.zev-cai-back:hover {
    color: var(--text) !important;
    background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.04);
}

/* =========================================================
   MAIN
   ========================================================= */

.zev-cai-main {
    width: calc(100% - 270px);
    max-width: 1440px;
    margin: 0 auto;
    padding: 38px 44px 60px;
}

.zev-cai-header {
    display: flex;
    align-items: flex-start;
    justify-content: space-between;
    gap: 30px;
    margin-bottom: 35px;
}

.zev-cai-eyebrow {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 8px;
    margin-bottom: 9px;
    color: #9aa5b6;
    font-size: 10px;
    font-weight: 700;
    letter-spacing: 0.13em;
}

.zev-cai-status-dot {
    width: 7px;
    height: 7px;
    border-radius: 50%;
    background: var(--green);
    box-shadow: 0 0 10px rgba(121, 242, 166, 0.7);
}

.zev-cai-header h1 {
    margin: 0;
    color: var(--text);
    font-size: clamp(31px, 4vw, 45px);
    line-height: 1.08;
    letter-spacing: -0.04em;
}

.zev-cai-header p {
    margin: 9px 0 0;
    color: var(--muted);
    font-size: 14px;
}

.zev-cai-profile-link {
    min-height: 42px;
    padding: 0 15px;
    border: 1px solid var(--border);
    border-radius: 10px;
    display: inline-flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 8px;
    color: #dce2eb !important;
    background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.025);
    text-decoration: none !important;
    font-size: 12px;
    font-weight: 600;
    transition: 0.2s ease;
}

.zev-cai-profile-link:hover {
    border-color: var(--border-hover);
    background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.05);
}

/* =========================================================
   TOOLKIT
   ========================================================= */

.zev-cai-toolkit {
    margin-bottom: 28px;
}

.zev-cai-section-heading {
    display: flex;
    align-items: flex-end;
    justify-content: space-between;
    gap: 20px;
    margin-bottom: 16px;
}

.zev-cai-section-kicker {
    display: block;
    margin-bottom: 4px;
    color: var(--muted-2);
    font-size: 9px;
    font-weight: 750;
    letter-spacing: 0.14em;
}

.zev-cai-section-heading h2 {
    margin: 0;
    color: #e9edf4;
    font-size: 18px;
    letter-spacing: -0.02em;
}

.zev-cai-grounded {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 7px;
    color: var(--muted);
    font-size: 10px;
}

.zev-cai-grounded > span {
    width: 6px;
    height: 6px;
    border-radius: 50%;
    background: var(--green);
}

.zev-cai-tools {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: repeat(3, minmax(0, 1fr));
    gap: 10px;
}

.zev-cai-tool-card {
    min-height: 112px;
    padding: 17px;
    border: 1px solid var(--border);
    border-radius: 14px;
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: 37px 1fr 20px;
    align-items: flex-start;
    gap: 12px;
    text-align: left;
    cursor: pointer;
    background:
        linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.025), transparent 55%),
        var(--panel);
    transition: transform 0.2s ease, border-color 0.2s ease, background 0.2s ease;
}

.zev-cai-tool-card:hover {
    transform: translateY(-2px);
    border-color: rgba(121, 242, 166, 0.2);
    background:
        linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(121, 242, 166, 0.05), transparent 55%),
        var(--panel-2);
}

.zev-cai-tool-icon {
    width: 37px;
    height: 37px;
    border: 1px solid rgba(121, 242, 166, 0.13);
    border-radius: 10px;
    display: grid;
    place-items: center;
    background: rgba(121, 242, 166, 0.07);
    color: var(--green);
    font-size: 16px;
}

.zev-cai-tool-card h3 {
    margin: 1px 0 4px;
    color: #eef2f7;
    font-size: 13px;
    font-weight: 650;
}

.zev-cai-tool-card p {
    margin: 0;
    color: var(--muted);
    font-size: 11px;
    line-height: 1.55;
}

.zev-cai-tool-arrow {
    align-self: center;
    color: #586373;
    font-size: 16px;
    transition: 0.2s ease;
}

.zev-cai-tool-card:hover .zev-cai-tool-arrow {
    color: var(--green);
    transform: translateX(2px);
}

/* =========================================================
   CHAT
   ========================================================= */

.zev-cai-chat-shell {
    overflow: hidden;
    border: 1px solid var(--border);
    border-radius: 17px;
    background:
        radial-gradient(circle at 50% 0%, rgba(102, 115, 255, 0.05), transparent 35%),
        rgba(10, 14, 20, 0.92);
    box-shadow: 0 18px 60px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.22);
}

.zev-cai-chat-topbar {
    min-height: 67px;
    padding: 0 19px;
    border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border);
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: space-between;
}

.zev-cai-ai-identity {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 11px;
}

.zev-cai-ai-logo {
    width: 36px;
    height: 36px;
    border-radius: 10px;
    display: grid;
    place-items: center;
    color: #09110c;
    background: linear-gradient(135deg, #89f6ad, #66e0bd);
    font-size: 15px;
}

.zev-cai-ai-identity strong,
.zev-cai-ai-identity span {
    display: block;
}

.zev-cai-ai-identity strong {
    color: #edf2f8;
    font-size: 13px;
}

.zev-cai-ai-identity span {
    margin-top: 2px;
    color: var(--muted);
    font-size: 10px;
}

.zev-cai-icon-button {
    width: 34px;
    height: 34px;
    padding: 0;
    border: 1px solid var(--border);
    border-radius: 9px;
    display: grid;
    place-items: center;
    cursor: pointer;
    background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.025);
    color: #cbd3df !important;
    font-size: 17px !important;
    transition: 0.2s ease;
}

.zev-cai-icon-button:hover {
    border-color: var(--border-hover);
    background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.055);
}

.zev-cai-chat-messages {
    height: 440px;
    overflow-y: auto;
    padding: 24px;
    scroll-behavior: smooth;
}

.zev-cai-welcome {
    max-width: 670px;
    min-height: 380px;
    margin: auto;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    text-align: center;
}

.zev-cai-welcome-icon {
    width: 48px;
    height: 48px;
    margin-bottom: 15px;
    border: 1px solid rgba(121, 242, 166, 0.16);
    border-radius: 14px;
    display: grid;
    place-items: center;
    color: var(--green);
    background: var(--green-soft);
    box-shadow: 0 0 35px rgba(121, 242, 166, 0.06);
    font-size: 20px;
}

.zev-cai-welcome h2 {
    margin: 0 0 8px;
    color: #f1f4f8;
    font-size: 23px;
    letter-spacing: -0.03em;
}

.zev-cai-welcome > p {
    max-width: 560px;
    margin: 0;
    color: var(--muted);
    font-size: 12px;
    line-height: 1.7;
}

.zev-cai-prompts {
    width: 100%;
    max-width: 610px;
    margin-top: 24px;
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr));
    gap: 8px;
}

.zev-cai-prompt {
    min-height: 45px;
    padding: 10px 13px;
    border: 1px solid var(--border);
    border-radius: 10px;
    cursor: pointer;
    text-align: left;
    background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.02);
    color: #b9c2cf !important;
    font-size: 11px !important;
    transition: 0.2s ease;
}

.zev-cai-prompt:hover {
    border-color: rgba(121, 242, 166, 0.2);
    color: #eaf5ee !important;
    background: rgba(121, 242, 166, 0.045);
}

/* Future JS chat message styling */
.zev-cai-message {
    width: 100%;
    margin-bottom: 20px;
    display: flex;
    gap: 10px;
    align-items: flex-start;
}

.zev-cai-message-user {
    justify-content: flex-end;
}

.zev-cai-message-avatar {
    width: 30px;
    height: 30px;
    flex: 0 0 30px;
    border-radius: 8px;
    display: grid;
    place-items: center;
    background: var(--green-soft);
    color: var(--green);
    font-size: 11px;
}

.zev-cai-message-content {
    max-width: min(720px, 78%);
    padding: 12px 14px;
    border: 1px solid var(--border);
    border-radius: 12px;
    background: var(--panel-2);
    color: #cdd5df;
    font-size: 12px;
    line-height: 1.7;
    white-space: pre-wrap;
    word-break: break-word;
}

.zev-cai-message-user .zev-cai-message-content {
    border-color: rgba(121, 242, 166, 0.14);
    background: rgba(121, 242, 166, 0.075);
    color: #e5ece8;
}

/* =========================================================
   TYPING
   ========================================================= */

.zev-cai-typing {
    padding: 0 24px 14px;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 10px;
}

.zev-cai-typing[hidden] {
    display: none !important;
}

.zev-cai-typing-bubble {
    height: 34px;
    padding: 0 13px;
    border: 1px solid var(--border);
    border-radius: 10px;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 4px;
    background: var(--panel-2);
}

.zev-cai-typing-bubble span {
    width: 5px;
    height: 5px;
    border-radius: 50%;
    background: #8d98a7;
    animation: zevCaiTyping 1.1s infinite ease-in-out;
}

.zev-cai-typing-bubble span:nth-child(2) {
    animation-delay: 0.15s;
}

.zev-cai-typing-bubble span:nth-child(3) {
    animation-delay: 0.3s;
}

@keyframes zevCaiTyping {
    0%,
    60%,
    100% {
        opacity: 0.35;
        transform: translateY(0);
    }

    30% {
        opacity: 1;
        transform: translateY(-3px);
    }
}

/* =========================================================
   COMPOSER
   ========================================================= */

.zev-cai-composer-wrap {
    padding: 15px 18px 14px;
    border-top: 1px solid var(--border);
    background: rgba(6, 9, 13, 0.58);
}

.zev-cai-composer {
    min-height: 52px;
    padding: 7px 7px 7px 15px;
    border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1);
    border-radius: 13px;
    display: flex;
    align-items: flex-end;
    gap: 10px;
    background: #0d1219;
    transition: 0.2s ease;
}

.zev-cai-composer:focus-within {
    border-color: rgba(121, 242, 166, 0.3);
    box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(121, 242, 166, 0.04);
}

#zev-cai-input {
    width: 100%;
    min-height: 35px;
    max-height: 130px;
    padding: 8px 0;
    border: 0 !important;
    outline: 0 !important;
    resize: none;
    overflow-y: auto;
    background: transparent !important;
    box-shadow: none !important;
    color: #e9eef5 !important;
    font-size: 12px;
    line-height: 1.5;
}

#zev-cai-input::placeholder {
    color: #626d7c;
}

#zev-cai-send {
    width: 38px;
    height: 38px;
    min-width: 38px;
    padding: 0;
    border: 0;
    border-radius: 10px;
    display: grid;
    place-items: center;
    cursor: pointer;
    background: var(--green);
    color: #07100b !important;
    font-size: 19px !important;
    font-weight: 800;
    transition: 0.2s ease;
}

#zev-cai-send:hover {
    transform: translateY(-1px);
    filter: brightness(1.05);
}

#zev-cai-send:disabled {
    opacity: 0.45;
    cursor: not-allowed;
    transform: none;
}

.zev-cai-composer-meta {
    margin-top: 7px;
    padding: 0 3px;
    display: flex;
    justify-content: space-between;
    gap: 15px;
    color: #626d7c;
    font-size: 9px;
}

/* =========================================================
   MODAL
   ========================================================= */

.zev-cai-modal {
    position: fixed;
    inset: 0;
    z-index: 999999;
    display: grid;
    place-items: center;
    padding: 22px;
}

.zev-cai-modal[hidden] {
    display: none !important;
}

.zev-cai-modal-backdrop {
    position: absolute;
    inset: 0;
    background: rgba(2, 4, 7, 0.78);
    backdrop-filter: blur(8px);
}

.zev-cai-modal-card {
    position: relative;
    z-index: 1;
    width: min(760px, 100%);
    max-height: 86vh;
    overflow-y: auto;
    padding: 24px;
    border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1);
    border-radius: 18px;
    background:
        radial-gradient(circle at 100% 0%, rgba(105, 83, 255, 0.08), transparent 35%),
        #0c1118;
    box-shadow: 0 30px 100px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.5);
}

.zev-cai-modal-header {
    display: flex;
    justify-content: space-between;
    gap: 20px;
    padding-bottom: 18px;
    border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border);
}

#zev-cai-modal-kicker {
    display: block;
    margin-bottom: 4px;
    color: var(--green);
    font-size: 9px;
    font-weight: 700;
    letter-spacing: 0.13em;
}

.zev-cai-modal-header h2 {
    margin: 0;
    color: #f1f4f8;
    font-size: 21px;
}

.zev-cai-modal-close {
    width: 34px;
    height: 34px;
    padding: 0;
    border: 1px solid var(--border);
    border-radius: 9px;
    display: grid;
    place-items: center;
    cursor: pointer;
    background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.025);
    color: #aab4c2 !important;
    font-size: 19px !important;
}

.zev-cai-modal-form,
.zev-cai-modal-result {
    padding-top: 20px;
}

.zev-cai-modal-result:empty {
    display: none;
}

.zev-cai-modal-loading {
    min-height: 220px;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    text-align: center;
}

.zev-cai-modal-loading[hidden] {
    display: none !important;
}

.zev-cai-modal-loading strong {
    margin-top: 15px;
    color: #e6ebf2;
    font-size: 13px;
}

.zev-cai-modal-loading span {
    margin-top: 4px;
    color: var(--muted);
    font-size: 10px;
}

.zev-cai-loader {
    width: 35px;
    height: 35px;
    border: 3px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08);
    border-top-color: var(--green);
    border-radius: 50%;
    animation: zevCaiSpin 0.75s linear infinite;
}

@keyframes zevCaiSpin {
    to {
        transform: rotate(360deg);
    }
}

/* Fields/results used by upcoming JS */
.zev-cai-field {
    margin-bottom: 15px;
}

.zev-cai-field label {
    display: block;
    margin-bottom: 6px;
    color: #cbd3dd;
    font-size: 11px;
    font-weight: 600;
}

.zev-cai-field input,
.zev-cai-field select {
    width: 100%;
    min-height: 43px;
    padding: 0 12px;
    border: 1px solid var(--border) !important;
    border-radius: 10px;
    outline: none;
    background: #0a0f15 !important;
    color: #e4e9f0 !important;
    font-size: 12px;
}

.zev-cai-field input:focus,
.zev-cai-field select:focus {
    border-color: rgba(121, 242, 166, 0.3) !important;
}

.zev-cai-modal-action {
    min-height: 43px;
    padding: 0 16px;
    border: 0;
    border-radius: 10px;
    cursor: pointer;
    background: var(--green);
    color: #07100b !important;
    font-size: 11px !important;
    font-weight: 750;
}

.zev-cai-result-card {
    margin-bottom: 10px;
    padding: 14px;
    border: 1px solid var(--border);
    border-radius: 11px;
    background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.022);
}

.zev-cai-result-card h3 {
    margin: 0 0 7px;
    color: #edf1f6;
    font-size: 13px;
}

.zev-cai-result-card p,
.zev-cai-result-card li {
    color: #a8b2c0;
    font-size: 11px;
    line-height: 1.65;
}

.zev-cai-result-card ul {
    margin: 7px 0 0;
    padding-left: 18px;
}

.zev-cai-score {
    width: 72px;
    height: 72px;
    margin-bottom: 15px;
    border: 1px solid rgba(121, 242, 166, 0.18);
    border-radius: 50%;
    display: grid;
    place-items: center;
    background: var(--green-soft);
    color: var(--green);
    font-size: 19px;
    font-weight: 750;
}

/* =========================================================
   TOAST
   ========================================================= */

.zev-cai-toast {
    position: fixed;
    right: 22px;
    bottom: 22px;
    z-index: 1000000;
    max-width: 340px;
    padding: 12px 15px;
    border: 1px solid var(--border);
    border-radius: 10px;
    background: #121821;
    color: #dfe5ed;
    box-shadow: 0 15px 50px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.35);
    font-size: 11px;
}

.zev-cai-toast[hidden] {
    display: none !important;
}

/* =========================================================
   RESPONSIVE
   ========================================================= */

@media (max-width: 1050px) {
    .zev-cai-sidebar {
        width: 225px;
        min-width: 225px;
    }

    .zev-cai-main {
        width: calc(100% - 225px);
        padding: 32px 25px 50px;
    }

    .zev-cai-tools {
        grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr));
    }
}

@media (max-width: 760px) {
    #zev-career-ai {
        display: block;
    }

    .zev-cai-sidebar {
        position: relative;
        width: 100%;
        min-width: 0;
        min-height: auto;
        padding: 15px;
        border-right: 0;
        border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border);
    }

    .zev-cai-brand {
        margin-bottom: 14px;
    }

    .zev-cai-sidebar-label,
    .zev-cai-conversations,
    .zev-cai-sidebar-bottom {
        display: none;
    }

    .zev-cai-new-chat {
        min-height: 41px;
    }

    .zev-cai-main {
        width: 100%;
        padding: 25px 15px 40px;
    }

    .zev-cai-header {
        align-items: flex-start;
        margin-bottom: 27px;
    }

    .zev-cai-profile-link {
        padding: 0 11px;
    }

    .zev-cai-section-heading {
        align-items: flex-start;
        flex-direction: column;
        gap: 8px;
    }

    .zev-cai-tools {
        grid-template-columns: 1fr;
    }

    .zev-cai-tool-card {
        min-height: 100px;
    }

    .zev-cai-chat-messages {
        height: 500px;
        padding: 18px 13px;
    }

    .zev-cai-prompts {
        grid-template-columns: 1fr;
    }

    .zev-cai-message-content {
        max-width: 88%;
    }

    .zev-cai-composer-wrap {
        padding: 12px;
    }

    .zev-cai-composer-meta span:first-child {
        display: none;
    }

    .zev-cai-composer-meta {
        justify-content: flex-end;
    }
}

@media (max-width: 480px) {
    .zev-cai-header {
        display: block;
    }

    .zev-cai-profile-link {
        margin-top: 15px;
    }

    .zev-cai-header h1 {
        font-size: 32px;
    }

    .zev-cai-modal {
        padding: 10px;
    }

    .zev-cai-modal-card {
        padding: 18px;
        border-radius: 14px;
    }
}

.zev-cai-conversation-item {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) 28px;
    gap: 4px;
    margin-bottom: 4px;
    border-radius: 9px;
}

.zev-cai-conversation-item.is-active {
    background: rgba(121, 242, 166, 0.07);
}

.zev-cai-conversation-open,
.zev-cai-conversation-delete {
    border: 0;
    cursor: pointer;
    background: transparent;
}

.zev-cai-conversation-open {
    overflow: hidden;
    min-height: 39px;
    padding: 0 9px;
    color: #98a3b2 !important;
    text-align: left;
    text-overflow: ellipsis;
    white-space: nowrap;
    font-size: 11px !important;
}

.zev-cai-conversation-item:hover {
    background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.035);
}

.zev-cai-conversation-item.is-active .zev-cai-conversation-open {
    color: #dff8e8 !important;
}

.zev-cai-conversation-delete {
    color: #606b79 !important;
    font-size: 15px !important;
}

.zev-cai-conversation-delete:hover {
    color: #ff8c96 !important;
}
/* ===== CAREER AI FINAL RESULT + MARKDOWN STYLES ===== */

.zev-cai-message-content strong {
    color: #f0f5f8;
    font-weight: 700;
}

.zev-cai-ai-heading {
    margin: 10px 0 5px;
    color: #f1f5f8;
    font-weight: 700;
}

.zev-cai-ai-list-item {
    display: flex;
    align-items: flex-start;
    gap: 8px;
    margin: 5px 0;
}

.zev-cai-ai-list-number {
    min-width: 18px;
    color: var(--green);
    font-weight: 700;
}

.zev-cai-score-wrap {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 14px;
    margin-bottom: 18px;
}

.zev-cai-score-wrap .zev-cai-score {
    margin: 0;
}

.zev-cai-score-wrap > div:last-child strong,
.zev-cai-score-wrap > div:last-child span {
    display: block;
}

.zev-cai-score-wrap > div:last-child strong {
